{"[2020DO10729]": "상고이유를 판단한다.

1. a. When investigative agencies execute a warrant of seizure and search, 피압수자 또는 defense counsel may participate in its execution (Articles 219 and 121 of the Criminal Procedure Act). Even where, in the course of a seizure and search of storage media, it is impossible to print and duplicate within the fixed scope, or where exceptional circumstances are recognized in which it is markedly difficult to accomplish the purpose of seizure, and the storage media containing electronic information, hard copies, or imaging and other forms (hereinafter referred to as the “duplicate copy”) are moved to the investigative agency’s office, etc. for duplication, examination, and printing, the principles of warrant issuance and due process must still be observed by guaranteeing the opportunity for the person from whom items are seized or the defense counsel to participate and by taking 적절한 measures to prevent arbitrary duplication, etc. of electronic information unrelated to the alleged facts. If such measures were not taken, then, unless there are special circumstances such as where the side of the person from whom items were seized explicitly indicated an intention not to participate in the above procedures or process, or where it cannot be said that the purpose of guaranteeing participation in the procedure was substantially infringed in light of the nature and content of the process in which the procedural violation occurred, the seizure and search cannot be said to be lawful. The same applies even where the investigative agency duplicated and printed only the electronic information related to the alleged facts from the storage media or the duplicate copy (see Supreme Court en banc Decision dated 2015. 7. 16. in 2011MO1839, Supreme Court Judgment dated 2017. 9. 21. in 2015DO12400, etc.).

Meanwhile, the defense counsel’s right to participate, as provided in Articles 219 and 121 of the Criminal Procedure Act, is an inherent right granted to the defense counsel for the protection of the person from whom items are seized. Therefore, even if the person from whom items were seized explicitly indicated to the investigative agency an intention not to participate in the execution of the warrant of seizure and search, the defense counsel must, unless special circumstances exist, be separately guaranteed an opportunity to participate in the execution of the warrant of seizure and search by being notified in advance of the time and place of execution pursuant to Articles 219 and 122 of the Criminal Procedure Act.

b. Article 308-2 of the Criminal Procedure Act provides that “evidence collected in violation of lawful procedures shall not be admissible as evidence.” This explicitly sets forth the exclusionary rule for illegally obtained evidence in order to realize the constitutional ideal of guaranteeing the fundamental human rights of the people by suppressing unlawful acts in investigative processes, including unlawful seizure and search, and preventing their recurrence (see Supreme Court Judgment dated 2013. 3. 14. in 2010DO2094, Supreme Court Judgment dated 2019. 7. 11. in 2018DO20504, etc.). Article 12 of the Constitution declares the principles of due process and warrant issuance with respect to seizure and search in order to guarantee fundamental human rights, and the Criminal Procedure Act inherits this and establishes specific standards concerning seizure and search procedures so as to harmoniously realize the ideals of discovering substantive truth and protecting individual rights. Since it is necessary to firmly maintain the normative force of the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act and to suppress unlawful acts in investigative processes, evidence collected not only in violation of lawful procedures but also secondary evidence obtained on the basis thereof should be regarded as having been secured without lawful procedures prepared for the protection of fundamental human rights and, in principle, cannot be used as evidence for conviction.

However, uniformly denying evidentiary admissibility merely because evidence was collected without following the procedures prescribed by law does not accord with the purposes of the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act. This is because the realization of legitimate punitive power through the discovery of substantive truth is also an important goal and ideal that the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act seek to achieve through criminal procedure. If the investigative agency’s procedural violation does not amount to an infringement of the substantive content of due process, and rather it is an exceptional case in which excluding evidentiary admissibility would be evaluated as producing a result contrary to the intent of the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act in establishing procedural provisions for criminal procedure so as to seek harmony between the principle of due process and the discovery of substantive truth and thereby realize criminal justice, the court should find that such evidence may be used as evidence for conviction. Whether this applies must be determined by comprehensively and holistically examining all circumstances relating to the procedural violation committed in the course of the investigative agency’s collection of evidence, namely, the purport of the procedural provision, the content and degree of the violation, the specific circumstances and avoidability of the violation, the nature of the rights or legal interests that the procedural provision seeks to protect and the degree of infringement, the relationship between such rights or legal interests and the defendant, the relationship between the procedural violation and the collection of evidence, and the investigative agency’s awareness and intent. Since this legal principle applies equally to secondary evidence obtained on the basis of evidence collected without lawful procedures, secondary evidence may also be used as evidence for conviction in exceptional cases by comprehensively and holistically considering all circumstances relating to the collection of secondary evidence, focusing on whether the causal relationship between the collection of evidence without procedure and the collection of secondary evidence has been attenuated or severed (see Supreme Court en banc Decision dated 2007. 11. 15. in 2007DO3061, Supreme Court en banc Decision dated 2015. 1. 22. in 2014DO10978, Supreme Court Judgment dated 2019. 7. 11. in 2018DO20504, etc.).

2. a. The gist of the charged facts at issue in this case is as follows.

The Defendant, at an unknown time in or before 2019, in the restroom of “○○ Singing Practice Room” located in Uijeongbu-si (address omitted), attached, by using tape, a small camera wrapped in vinyl to the outside of a trash can inside the toilet stall there, attached a portable battery connected to the above camera to the inside of the trash can, and then pressed the record button, thereby filming the buttocks and genitals of an unidentified female who was using the toilet in that restroom; in addition, from around 2013 to around 2019, the Defendant filmed the victims using the toilet in restrooms on a total of 296 occasions as set forth in numbers 1 through 296 of the crime list table cited in the judgment below. In this way, the Defendant, by using a camera or any other mechanical device with a similar function, filmed the body of another person that may arouse sexual desire or cause shame, against that person’s will.

b. The lower court, for the following reasons, found that this portion of the charged facts fell under a case in which the facts constituting the offense were not proven, and thus reversed the first-instance judgment that had found the Defendant guilty and held him not guilty.

1) The investigative agency violated due process by executing the warrant of seizure and search on 2019. 10. 30. in the investigative agency’s office by searching, duplicating, and printing the storage media, without having previously notified the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel of the time and place of execution.

2) Considering that the Defendant was then in custody and the importance of the participation procedure prescribed in Articles 219 and 121 of the Criminal Procedure Act, the above violation of due process was serious in degree.

3) Therefore, video capture printouts, etc. collected through the unlawful seizure and search cannot be used as evidence pursuant to Article 308-2 of the Criminal Procedure Act, and the Defendant’s confession is also a product based on those pieces of evidence or the only evidence for this portion of the charged facts, so it cannot be used as evidence of guilt pursuant to Article 308-2 or Article 310 of the Criminal Procedure Act.

3. The lower court’s above determination cannot be accepted as is for the following reasons.

a. According to the reasoning of the lower court judgment and the record, the following facts may be found.

1) A judicial police officer affiliated with the Gyeonggi Uijeongbu Police Station, Police Lieutenant Nonparty 1, on 2019. 10. 25. at around 09:00, removed from the Defendant’s residence to the police station, by way of taking them out, one computer main unit owned by the Defendant (hereinafter referred to as the “computer at issue”) and one Galaxy Note8 mobile phone (hereinafter referred to as the “mobile phone at issue”), on the basis of the search, seizure, and inspection warrant dated 2019. 10. 24. issued by a judge of the Uijeongbu District Court (hereinafter referred to as the “warrant at issue”).

2) At that time, the Defendant handwrote a “V” mark and signed and affixed his thumbprint on the portions of the confirmation forms for removal of the original for the computer at issue and the mobile phone at issue stating, “I participated in the process of sealing the digital device and storage media and confirmed that there was no problem with the sealing; I was notified that I may participate in the process of unsealing, obtaining the duplicate copy, and searching, duplicating, and printing the digital device, storage media, or duplicate copy; and I will not participate in the above process.”

3) In the first police interrogation of the suspect immediately thereafter, the Defendant stated, “Since 4 to 5 years ago, I installed a hidden camera purchased online in trash cans in restrooms of PC rooms, singing rooms, etc. and filmed women’s genitals, etc., and stored the videos on the hard disk of the computer at issue.”

4) Police Sergeant Nonparty 2, affiliated with the Gyeonggi Uijeongbu Police Station, searched the hard disk of the computer at issue on 2019. 10. 25., discovered a number of video files that appeared to have been filmed by the Defendant with a hidden camera, prepared an investigative report to that effect, and attached thereto photographs of the folder screen where the video files were stored.

5) Meanwhile, the Prosecutor filed an application for an arrest warrant against the Defendant on 2019. 10. 25., and a judge of the Uijeongbu District Court, after appointing Attorney Nonparty 3 as the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel on 2019. 10. 26., conducted a pre-arrest suspect interrogation of the Defendant and issued the arrest warrant.

6) In the second police interrogation of the suspect on 2019. 10. 29., the Defendant stated, “From around 2011 to around 2019, I installed hidden cameras in the restrooms of six places in total, including the places of offense stated in the charged facts at issue in this case, such as PC rooms, hospitals, and singing rooms, and filmed other persons’ bodies,” while specifying the places of offense by year.

7) Police Lieutenant Nonparty 1, Police Sergeant Nonparty 4, and Police Corporal Nonparty 2, affiliated with the Gyeonggi Uijeongbu Police Station, each took charge of one of the three hard disks built into the computer at issue and searched them in their office on 2019. 10. 30., then captured the playback scene of the illegal filming video they each found (one scene per video file) and printed it together with the captured image of the corresponding video file information (all such printouts are hereinafter referred to as the “printouts at issue”).

8) However, the investigative agency did not give advance notice to the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel concerning the above search and duplication of the computer at issue and the procedure for creation of the printouts at issue, and neither the Defendant nor the above court-appointed defense counsel participated in those procedures.

b. In light of the foregoing legal principles, when examining the above factual relationship, even if the Defendant indicated to the investigative agency an intention not to participate in the process of searching, duplicating, and printing the computer at issue, the investigative agency should have provided the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel with an opportunity to participate in the above procedure by notifying him in advance of the time and place of execution before searching, duplicating, and printing the storage medium, namely, the computer at issue, in the investigative agency’s office on 2019. 10. 30.; yet it did not do so. Therefore, the lower court’s determination that the investigative agency executing the warrant at issue violated the seizure procedure is proper, and there is no illegality in the lower court’s above determination that violated no rules of logic or experience, did not exceed the limits of free evaluation of evidence, and did not misapprehend the legal principles regarding the nature of the defense counsel’s right to participate.

c. 1) However, when all of the following circumstances ascertainable through the above factual relationship and the record are comprehensively considered, the above procedural violation by the investigative agency does not amount to an infringement of the substantive content of due process, and rather there is ample room to view this as an exceptional case in which excluding the admissibility of evidence collected through the execution of the warrant at issue would produce a result contrary to the intent of the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act in establishing procedural provisions regarding criminal procedure so as to seek harmony between the principle of due process and the discovery of substantive truth and thereby realize criminal justice.

a) On 2019. 10. 25., the investigative agency, after confirming from the Defendant, who was then the only person entitled to participate as the person from whom items were seized, that he did not wish to participate in the process of searching, duplicating, and printing the computer at issue, began the search of the computer at issue. At the time of the search, the Defendant had already stated that “illegal filming videos are stored on the hard disk of the computer at issue.”

b) By the time the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel was appointed, it appears that the investigative agency had already carried out the search of the computer at issue to some extent and had identified at least the location of the folder where the seized electronic information was stored.

c) The Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel had not inquired of the investigative agency about the status of execution of the warrant at issue, nor had he requested participation in the process.

d) At the time of execution of the warrant at issue, there was no established precedent or internal guideline of the investigative agency that the defense counsel appointed or selected after the commencement of the seizure and search procedure had to be separately notified in advance notwithstanding the person from whom items were seized having waived or refused participation.

e) In the course of executing the warrant at issue, the investigative agency seized videos that the Defendant had recorded, through hidden cameras installed in restrooms of PC rooms, singing rooms, etc. since around 2011, of the bodies of hundreds of victims, and indicted him for 296 of those acts (the charged facts at issue in this case). The Defendant confessed to all of those offenses in the investigative agency and in court.

2) If so, the lower court should have carefully determined, by comprehensively considering the circumstances of the seizure and search pursuant to the warrant at issue, the provisions relating to seizure procedures for electronic information in force at the time of execution of the warrant at issue, the probative purpose of the seized evidence, the circumstances that led to the procedural violation and the investigative agency’s awareness and intent regarding it, and the content and nature of the offense in this case, whether this case falls under an exception to the exclusionary rule for illegally obtained evidence.

Nevertheless, the lower court, based solely on the reasons stated in its opinion, concluded that the evidence collected through the seizure and search pursuant to the warrant at issue could not be used as evidence of guilt and found the charged facts at issue in this case not guilty. In this respect, the lower court erred by misapprehending the legal principles concerning the exception to the exclusionary rule for illegally obtained evidence and by failing to conduct the necessary examination. The Prosecutor’s ground for appeal pointing out this error is well-founded.

4. Therefore, the portion of the lower court judgment finding not guilty is reversed, and the case is remanded to the lower court for retrial and reconsideration of this portion, and it is so adjudged in accordance with the unanimous opinion of the Justices participating."}

{"[2020DO14654]": "The grounds for final appeal를 판단한다.

1. 쟁점 공소사실의 요지

The Defendant, ① from around 2018. 1. 2. to around 2018. 12. 10., committed sexual abuse 행위 such as 성적 수치심을 주는 성희롱 against each of the 14 child and juvenile victims in the Attached Sheet of the judgment of the court below, “Amended Crime List I,” and at the same time produced obscene materials by using them; ② on 2019. 3. 1., distributed obscene materials using children and juveniles by transmitting photographs taken of the victim’s genital area, etc.; and ③ from around 2018. 6. 14. to around 2019. 1. 5., possessed a total of 229 items of obscene materials using children and juveniles.

2. Judgment concerning the seizure pursuant to the warrant in this case

A. The judgment of the court below

The court below, based on its 판시 이유, determined that the procedure by which the mobile phone in this case, etc. owned by the Defendant was seized from the Defendant’s residence pursuant to the warrant in this case was not unlawful, such as by violating the warrant principle or infringing the Defendant’s right to participate in the seizure and search proceedings.

B. Judgment of the Supreme Court

(1) Article 215(1) of the Criminal Procedure Act provides: “When necessary for a criminal investigation, the prosecutor may conduct seizure, search, or inspection by a warrant issued upon application to a judge of a district court, limited to property for which there are circumstances sufficient to suspect that the suspect committed the offense and which may be recognized as related to the case concerned.” Accordingly, if separate evidence unrelated to the criminal facts that formed the ground for issuance of the warrant is seized, such evidence cannot, in principle, be used as evidence of guilt. However, in the case of an offense that was the object of the seizure and search, or an offense related thereto, the results of such seizure and search may be used as evidence of guilt. A “crime related to the criminal suspicion stated in a seizure and search warrant” means a crime that has an objective connection with the suspected facts stated in the seizure and search warrant and a personal connection between the person subject to the warrant and the suspect. Among such crimes, “objective connection” with the suspected facts means a case directly related to the suspected facts themselves stated in the seizure and search warrant or to an offense having the same basic factual relationship as such facts; however, it may also be recognized where the evidence can be used as indirect evidence or circumstantial evidence to prove the motive and background of the offense, the means and method of the offense, the time and place of the offense, etc. At this time, objective connection should be recognized only where, taking into comprehensive consideration the content of the suspected facts stated in the seizure and search warrant, the object of the investigation, and the course of the investigation, there is a concrete and individual relationship, and such connection should not be deemed to exist merely because the suspected facts and the offense are of the same kind or similar. And the personal connection with the suspect refers to the offense of the person stated in the seizure and search warrant, but it may also be recognized in criminal cases against accomplices such as co-principals, instigators, and indirect principals, as well as necessary accomplices (see Supreme Court Decision 2016DO13489, decided 2017. 1. 25.; Supreme Court Decision 2017DO13458, decided 2017. 12. 5., etc.).

(2) According to the reasons of the judgment of the court below and the record, the following facts can be ascertained.

(a) The police, based on the results of seizure and search regarding the Defendant’s Facebook account through which the victim communicated, confirmed that the subscriber to the access IP address of the account through which the offender conversed with the victim via Facebook Messenger was Non-Indicted Person 1 (the Defendant’s mother). The police further confirmed that Non-Indicted Person 2 (the Defendant’s father) and Non-Indicted Person 3 (the Defendant’s younger brother) were residing together on the resident registration record of Non-Indicted Person 1. At the time, the Defendant was residing at the above Facebook access location, but because his resident registration address was different, he did not appear on Non-Indicted Person 1’s resident registration record. The police, after identifying Non-Indicted Person 3 as the suspect, applied for a seizure and search warrant, and the judge of the district court issued the instant warrant as requested by the police.

(b) In the instant warrant, the Defendant’s younger brother, “Non-Indicted Person 3,” is specified and stated as the suspect of the crime; “a. Jeollabuk-do, Jeonju-si (address omitted), b. the body of the suspect Non-Indicted Person 3 and the property possessed, owned, or held by the suspect” are specified and stated as the places, persons, or things to be searched and inspected; and “smartphones, etc., digital devices and storage media owned, possessed, held, managed, or used by the suspect Non-Indicted Person 3” are specified and stated as the items to be seized.

(c) When the police arrived at the Defendant’s residence to execute the instant warrant, the Defendant was absent because he had gone to work, and the police heard from Non-Indicted Person 1 and Non-Indicted Person 3 that the person who committed the instant charged facts was not Non-Indicted Person 3 but the Defendant.

(d) Accordingly, the police presented the instant warrant to Non-Indicted Person 1 and searched the above residence pursuant to the instant warrant and seized the instant mobile phone, etc. owned by the Defendant. At that site, the police prepared a seizure record for each of the seized items, and in the “seizure circumstances” section, they wrote: “Although Non-Indicted Person 3, residing at the Facebook access IP installation location, was identified as the suspect, upon on-site visit, the older brother, the Defendant, was residing there together in a separately divided household status, and after hearing the statements of the mother and Non-Indicted Person 3, it was confirmed that the actual suspect was the Defendant. However, because he was at work and absent at the time of execution of the warrant, the instant warrant was executed with the participation of the mother, Non-Indicted Person 1.”

(3) 위 facts together with the following circumstances in light of the legal principles discussed above, the seizure of the Defendant’s mobile phone, etc. by executing the instant warrant issued against a person other than the Defendant as the suspect was unlawful.

(a) In light of the spirit of due process and the warrant principle that the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act seek to realize, the words used by a judge when issuing a seizure and search warrant to specify the “items to be seized” must be strictly construed and must not be expansively or analogically construed to the disadvantage of the person subject to seizure, etc. (see Supreme Court Decision 2008DO763, decided 2009. 3. 12., etc.).

(b) The police applied for the instant warrant in order to seize items owned or possessed by Non-Indicted Person 3, by identifying Non-Indicted Person 3 as the suspect in this case, and the judge issued the instant warrant to permit seizure of items owned or possessed by Non-Indicted Person 3 in accordance with the purpose of that application. Therefore, according to the wording of the instant warrant, the person subject to the seizure and search is Non-Indicted Person 3, and the items to be seized are limited to those owned, possessed, held, managed, or used by Non-Indicted Person 3.

(c) Even if the police heard at the seizure and search site from another person that the true offender in this case was the Defendant, they cannot seize items owned by the Defendant contrary to the wording stated in the instant warrant. Even if there may be a recognized difference between coercive measures against property and coercive measures against persons in terms such as the degree of substantiation of the criminal facts, once a warrant has been issued identifying the suspect and the person subject to seizure, it cannot be regarded as lawful and valid to execute the warrant by construing another person as the person subject to seizure.

(4) Nevertheless, the court below, for the reasons stated in its holding, determined that the execution of the instant warrant was lawful; thus, the court below erred by misapprehending the legal principles concerning the unlawfulness of seizure procedures pursuant to a warrant issued against a person other than the Defendant as the suspect.

(5) However, among the instant mobile phone, etc. seized by executing the instant warrant, the file discovered in the E310K mobile phone cannot be regarded as relating to a crime connected with the suspected facts stated in the instant warrant, and thus lacks admissibility of evidence; and because no evidence that could be used as evidence of a crime was discovered in the remainder, the court below did not use as evidence of guilt the evidence obtained from the instant mobile phone, etc. that were unlawfully seized as above.

Accordingly, since the above error by the court below did not affect the outcome of the judgment, the Defendant’s argument in this part of the grounds for final appeal cannot be accepted.

3. Judgment concerning seizure by voluntary submission

A. The seizure and search by an investigative agency of electronic information such as e-mails stored in a suspect’s information processing device, such as a computer, against an internet service user who is the suspect is permitted by the interpretation of the Criminal Procedure Act as a coercive measure in rem against the owner or possessor of the electronic information. Even where the electronic information to be seized and searched is not contained in an information processing device, such as a computer, at the search location stated in the seizure and search warrant, but is stored in a storage medium such as a remote server managed by a third party, connected to the information processing device through an information and communications network, if the investigative agency, pursuant to a warrant issued in lieu of the access authority to the suspect’s email account, enters the suspect’s email account ID and password lawfully obtained by using the information processing device, such as a computer, at the search location stated in the warrant, thereby accessing the remote storage medium in the ordinary manner by which the suspect would access it and downloading or displaying on the screen of the information processing device at the search location the suspect’s email-related electronic information stored there, this also concerns electronic information belonging to or possessed by the suspect, and therefore the seizure and search of that electronic information need not be viewed differently (see Supreme Court Decision 2017DO9747, decided 2017. 11. 29.). If, when voluntarily submitting a mobile phone, the suspect voluntarily provided the investigative agency with the ID and password for accessing cloud storage, etc., with the intent to submit to the investigative agency electronic information stored not in the mobile phone but in remote locations such as the cloud, managed by a third party, then the electronic information stored in the cloud, etc. may be regarded as having been voluntarily submitted.

B. Judgment

The court below determined, for the reasons stated in its holding, that the Defendant, based on his voluntary intent, submitted the Samsung mobile phone Galaxy Note8 in his possession to the investigative agency, and voluntarily submitted to the investigative agency the SDCard stored files, Naver Cloud files, and Galaxy Note gallery files connected to the Galaxy Note8.

In light of the legal principles discussed above, the court below’s above determination is proper, and there is no error, as alleged in the grounds for final appeal, in misapprehending the legal principles concerning the unlawfulness of seizure procedures by voluntary submission, the admissibility of evidence voluntarily submitted, or the specification of the source of evidence, nor is there any error exceeding the bounds of the principle of free evaluation of evidence in violation of the rules of logic and experience.

4. Conclusion

Therefore, the appeal is dismissed, and it is so adjudged as stated in the disposition by the unanimous opinion of the Justices participating."}

{"[2021DO11170]": "상고이유(the contents of the supplemental appellate brief submitted after the period for submitting the appellate brief are considered only to the extent that they supplement valid grounds of appeal)를 판단한다.
1. 피고인의 grounds of appeal에 대하여
가. evidence admissibility를 다투는 grounds of appeal에 대하여
1) ○○대 강사휴게실 PC 2대(이하 ‘이 사건 각 PC’라 한다)에 저장된 electronic information의 증거능력
가) 관련 legal principles
(1) 전자정보가 저장된 information storage medium을 voluntarily submitted하는 경우 전자정보 seizure의 범위와 relevance의 판단 기준
헌법과 형사소송법이 구현하고자 하는 due process, warrant requirement, proportionality principle은 물론, 사생활의 비밀과 자유, informational self-determination right 및 property rights의 protection이라는 관점에서 information storage medium 내 electronic information이 가지는 중요성에 비추어 볼 때, information storage medium을 임의제출하는 사람이 거기에 담긴 electronic information을 지정하거나 submission scope를 한정하는 취지로 한 intention declaration은 strictly construed되어야 하고, 확인되지 않은 submitter의 의사를 investigative agency가 함부로 infer하는 것은 허용될 수 없다. 따라서 investigative agency가 submitter의 의사를 쉽게 확인할 수 있음에도 이를 확인하지 않은 채 특정 criminal suspicion facts와 관련된 electronic information과 그렇지 않은 electronic information이 혼재된 information storage medium을 voluntarily received한 경우, 그 information storage medium에 저장된 electronic information 전부가 voluntarily submitted되어 seized된 것으로 treated할 수는 없다.
전자정보를 seize하고자 하는 investigative agency가 information storage medium과 거기에 저장된 electronic information을 voluntary submission 방식으로 seize할 때, submitter의 specific submission scope에 관한 의사를 제대로 확인하지 않는 등의 reason으로 인해 voluntary submitter의 의사에 따른 electronic information seizure의 object and scope가 unclear하거나 알 수 없는 경우에는 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure의 motive가 된 criminal suspicion facts와 related되고 이를 prove할 수 있는 최소한의 가치가 있는 electronic information에 한하여 seizure의 object가 된다. 이때 criminal suspicion facts와 related된 electronic information에는 criminal suspicion facts 그 자체 또는 그와 basic factual relationship이 동일한 offense와 directly related된 것은 물론 offense motive와 background, means and method, time and place 등을 prove하기 위한 indirect evidence나 circumstantial evidence 등으로 사용될 수 있는 것도 포함될 수 있다. 다만 그 relevance는 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure의 motive가 된 criminal suspicion facts의 content와 investigation object, investigation course, voluntary submission process 등을 comprehensively 고려하여 concrete and individual nexus가 있는 경우에만 인정되고, criminal suspicion facts와 단순히 same kind 또는 similar offense라는 reason만으로 relatedness가 있다고 할 것은 아니다(대법원 2021. 11. 18. 선고 2016도348 전원합의체 판결 등 참조).
(2) search·copy·print 시 participation right 보장
압수의 대상이 되는 전자정보와 그렇지 않은 전자정보가 mixed된 information storage medium이나 그 copy본을 voluntarily received한 investigative agency가 그 information storage medium 등을 prosecution office 등으로 옮겨 이를 search·copy·print하는 경우, 그와 같은 series of processes에서 형사소송법 제219조, 제121조에서 규정하는 person subject to seizure/search(이하 ‘피압수자’라 한다)나 그 defense counsel에게 participation opportunity를 guarantee하고 seized electronic information의 file details가 specified된 seizure inventory를 prepare·deliver하여야 하며 criminal suspicion facts와 unrelated한 electronic information의 arbitrary copying 등을 막기 위한 appropriate measures를 취하는 등 warrant principle과 due process를 comply하여야 한다. 만약 그러한 measures가 취해지지 않았다면 피압수자 측이 participation하지 아니한다는 intention을 expressly indicated하였거나 voluntary submission의 purport와 course 또는 그 procedure violation이 이루어진 process의 nature and content 등에 비추어 피압수자 측에 procedural participation을 guarantee한 purpose가 substantially infringed되었다고 볼 수 없을 정도라는 등의 special circumstances가 없는 이상 seizure·search는 lawful하다고 평가할 수 없고, 비록 investigative agency가 information storage medium 또는 copy본에서 criminal suspicion facts와 related된 electronic information만을 copied·printed하였다 하더라도 달리 볼 것은 아니다.
나아가 victim 등 third party가 suspect의 ownership·management에 속하는 information storage medium을 warrant 없이 voluntarily submitted한 경우에는 실질적 피압수자인 suspect가 investigative agency로 하여금 그 electronic information 전부를 무제한 탐색하는 데 consent한 것으로 보기 어려울 뿐만 아니라 suspect 스스로 voluntarily submitted한 경우 suspect의 participation right 등이 guaranteed되어야 하는 것과 견주어 보더라도 special circumstances가 없는 한 형사소송법 제219조, 제121조, 제129조에 따라 suspect에게 participation right를 보장하고 seized electronic information list를 deliver하는 등 suspect의 procedural rights를 guarantee하기 위한 appropriate measures가 이루어져야 한다(위 대법원 2016도348 전원합의체 판결 등 참조).
이와 같이 information storage medium을 voluntarily submitted한 피압수자에 더하여 voluntary submitter 아닌 suspect에게도 participation right가 보장되어야 하는 ‘suspect의 ownership·management에 속하는 information storage medium’이라 함은, suspect가 seizure·search 당시 또는 이와 temporally proximate한 시기까지 해당 information storage medium을 actually dominate·manage하면서 그 information storage medium 내 electronic information 전반에 관한 exclusive management/disposition right를 possess·exercise하고, 달리 이를 자신의 의사에 따라 third party에게 transfer하거나 waive하지 아니한 경우로써, suspect를 그 information storage medium에 저장된 electronic information에 대하여 substantial person subject to seizure로 evaluate할 수 있는 경우를 말하는 것이다. 이에 해당하는지 여부는 civil law상 right attribution에 따른 legal·ex post facto judgment가 아니라 seizure·search 당시 externally and objectively recognizable factual condition을 basis로 판단하여야 한다. 이러한 information storage medium의 external·objective dominance·management 상태와 별도로 단지 suspect나 기타 third party가 과거 그 information storage medium의 use 내지 individual electronic information의 creation·use 등에 관여한 사실이 있다거나 그 과정에서 생성된 electronic information에 의해 identified되는 data subject에 해당한다는 사정만으로 그들을 substantially subjected to seizure/search된 parties로 treat하여야 하는 것은 아니다.
나) 인정 사실

(5) 공소외 2는 ○○대 측의 협조지시를 토대로 2019. 9. 10. 검찰수사관들에게 ○○대 ☆☆학부 building interior를 안내하는 등으로 investigation에 협조하던 중 검찰수사관의 request에 따라 검찰수사관이 이 사건 각 PC 중 1대를 operate하여 거기에 저장된 electronic information을 check할 수 있도록 하였다. 이처럼 공소외 2와 함께 있는 가운데 검찰수사관이 위 PC에 저장된 electronic information을 search하는 과정에서 공소외 3 관련 folder를 발견하였고, 그 탐색이 계속되던 중 위 PC에서 ‘퍽’ 소리가 나면서 전원이 off되는 situation이 발생하자, 검찰수사관은 위 공소외 2와 ○○대의 물품 관리를 총괄하는 administrative support office director 공소외 4에게 위 현장에서의 search를 중단하고 이 사건 각 PC를 검찰에 제출하여 줄 수 있는지 inquiry·request하였다.

(9) 그 후 검찰은 이 사건 각 PC에 대한 imaging 및 forensic work를 하여 electronic information을 extracted하였고, 이에 따라 ○○대 총장 명의 표창장에 관한 사문서위조 범행이 2013. 6. 16.경 이 사건 각 PC 중 1대를 이용하여 이루어진 정황이 discovered되었다.
(10) 이에 검찰은 2019. 11. 27. 서울중앙지방법원 2019고합738호 사건에서 ‘피고인이 2012. 9. 7. ○○대에서 ○○대 총장 직인을 임의로 날인하여 ○○대 총장 명의 표창장을 위조하였다.’는 기존 공소사실을, ‘피고인이 2013. 6. 16. 주거지에서 PC를 이용하여 전자파일로 ○○대 총장 명의 표창장을 위조하였다.’는 취지로 공소장변경허가 신청을 하였으나, 재판부로부터 공소사실의 동일성이 인정되지 않는다는 reason으로 허가를 받지 못하자, 2019. 12. 17. 서울중앙지방법원 2019고합1050호로 위 공소장변경허가 신청과 같은 content의 공소사실로 additional indictment를 하였다.
(11) 검찰은 2020. 2. 11. 공소외 2, 공소외 4에게 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted되어 압수된 electronic information의 file details가 specific된 list를 delivered하였다.
(12) 이 사건 각 PC에 stored된 electronic information은 2013. 6. 16. 사문서위조(서울중앙지방법원 2019고합1050호 공소사실) 등 이 사건 공소사실 중 공소외 1의 의학전문대학원 부정지원 관련 범행의 evidence로 used되었다.
다) 판단
(1) 이 사건 각 PC의 voluntary submission
앞서 본 legal principles에 비추어 위 인정 사실을 살펴보면, 이 사건 각 PC는 2019. 9. 10. 당시 specific person이 이를 specific purpose로 exclusively use하고 있던 것이 아니라, ○○대 관계자가 ○○대에서 shared PC로 use하거나 기타 방법으로 discretionary disposal할 것을 전제로 3년 가까이 강사휴게실 내에 보관하면서 ○○대 ☆☆학부 조교가 이 사건 각 PC에 대한 custody·management 업무를 수행하고 있던 것으로, 당시 위 custody·management 업무의 담당자인 조교 공소외 2와 ○○대 물품 관리를 총괄하는 행정지원처장 공소외 4가 ○○대 측의 position을 reflecting한 voluntary intention에 따라 이 사건 각 PC를 검찰에 submitted한 것이라고 인정된다.
(2) 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information에 대한 압수의 necessity와 relevance
(가) 앞서 본 legal principles에 비추어 보면, 원심이 information storage medium과 거기에 저장된 electronic information을 voluntary received하여 seize하는 경우에는 the object of seizure가 그 necessity와 relevance가 recognized되는 범위 내로 limited되는 것이 아니라고 premise하고, investigative agency가 공소외 2, 공소외 4에게 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information의 specific submission scope에 관한 의사를 확인하지 않았더라도 이 사건 각 PC와 거기에 저장된 electronic information 일체가 voluntarily submitted된 것으로 볼 수 있다고 conclude한 것은 wrong이다. 이 사건 각 PC는 피고인에 대한 criminal suspicion facts 관련 electronic information과 그렇지 않은 electronic information이 mixed된 information storage medium으로서, 이 경우 확인되지 않은 submitter의 의사를 arbitrary로 infer하여 PC에 저장된 electronic information 전부가 voluntarily submitted되어 seized된 것으로 treat하는 것은 principle적으로 허용될 수 없다.
(나) 이처럼 voluntary submitter의 의사에 따른 electronic information seizure의 object와 scope를 clearly 알 수 없는 경우에는 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure의 motive가 된 criminal suspicion facts와 related되고 이를 증명할 수 있는 minimum value가 있는 electronic information에 한하여 seizure의 object가 된다고 보아야 한다.
이 사건 각 PC의 voluntary submission 당시 피고인은 이미 공소외 1의 △△대 및 □□대 의학전문대학원 지원 과정에서 위조된 ○○대 총장 명의 표창장을 제출하였다는 취지의 위조사문서행사, 위 표창장 및 그 밖에 허위 경력의 기재로 인한 □□대 의학전문대학원 입학사정 업무에 관한 위계공무집행방해 등의 criminal suspicion facts로 수사를 받고 있었다.
따라서 피고인이 2013. 6. 16. 이 사건 각 PC 중 1대를 이용하여 위 표창장 위조행위를 하는 등 공소외 1의 의학전문대학원 부정지원 process에서 이 사건 각 PC를 use하여 generated된 electronic information은 위 criminal suspicion facts에 관한 offense의 motive와 background, means and method 등을 증명하기 위한 specific·individual nexus 있는 evidence에 해당한다고 볼 수 있고, 그 밖에 이 사건 investigation의 object와 course, voluntary submission process 등을 종합해 보더라도 그 necessity와 relevance를 recognize하기에 충분하다.
(다) 결국 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information 가운데 이 사건 공소사실 중 공소외 1의 의학전문대학원 부정지원 관련 범행의 evidence로 used된 부분은 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure의 necessity와 relevance가 모두 인정되므로, 앞서 본 원심판단의 법리상 잘못은 judgment result에 영향이 없다.
(3) 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information에 대한 search 및 extraction 등 과정에서의 participation right 보장
(가) 앞서 본 legal principles에 비추어 보면, 원심이 information storage medium 및 stored electronic information을 voluntary received하여 seize하는 경우에는 그 electronic information search 등의 process에서 principle적으로 피압수자 측이나 피의자 측에게 participation right를 인정할 여지가 없다는 purport로 설시한 것은 wrong이다.
이 사건 각 PC는 피고인에 대한 criminal suspicion facts와 related된 electronic information과 그렇지 않은 electronic information이 mixed된 information storage medium으로서, 검찰이 이를 공소외 2, 공소외 4로부터 voluntarily received하여 seize한 후 대검찰청 국가디지털포렌식센터로 옮겨 거기에 저장된 electronic information을 search하고 extracted하는 등의 process에서 principle적으로 피압수자인 ○○대 측에 participation opportunity를 guarantee하여야 하기 때문이다.
(나) 그런데 위 인정 사실에서 살펴본 바와 같이 이 사건 각 PC에서 criminal suspicion facts와 related된 electronic information을 search하고 extracted하는 series of course에 비추어 검찰이 피압수자 측인 공소외 2, 공소외 4에게 participation intention을 확인하고 opportunity를 afforded하였으나 피압수자 측이 이를 waivered하였다고 인정되므로, 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 electronic information의 압수·수색절차에 피압수자 측의 participation right를 보장하지 아니한 defect가 있다고 할 수는 없다.
나아가 압수·수색 대상인 information storage medium 내 electronic information의 distortion이나 혐의사실과 무관한 electronic information의 arbitrary copying 등을 막기 위한 appropriate measures의 일환으로 피압수자 측에 procedural participation을 보장한 purport(대법원 2011. 5. 26. 자 2009모1190 결정, 대법원 2015. 7. 16. 자 2011모1839 전원합의체 결정 등 참조)에 비추어 이 사건 압수·수색의 entire process를 살펴볼 때, 공소외 2에게 이 사건 각 PC의 voluntary submission에 따른 압수 당시 criminal suspicion facts에 대한 detailed notification 등의 additional measure가 이루어지지 않았다는 등 피고인이 주장하는 reason만으로는 피압수자 측에 procedural participation을 guarantee한 purport가 substantially infringed되었다고 볼 수도 없다.
(다) 또한 앞서 본 legal principles를 토대로 위 인정 사실을 살펴보면, 이 사건 각 PC의 voluntary submission에 따른 압수·수색 당시 externally·objectively recognizable factual condition을 기준으로 볼 때, 이 사건 각 PC나 거기에 저장된 electronic information이 피고인의 ownership·management에 속한 경우에 해당한다고 인정되지 않는다. 오히려 ○○대 측이 이 사건 각 PC를 2016. 12.경 이후 3년 가까이 강사휴게실 내에 보관하면서 realistically dominate·manage하는 한편, 이를 shared PC로 use하거나 discretionary disposal 등의 measures를 할 수 있었던 것으로 보이는 등의 objective circumstances에 비추어 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information 전반에 관하여 당시 ○○대 측이 comprehensive management/disposition right를 사실상 possess·exercise하고 있는 state에 있었다고 인정된다.
피고인이 2016. 12.경 이전에 이 사건 각 PC를 피고인의 residence 등으로 가져가 exclusive하게 이용한 바 있다거나, 2016. 12.경 이후 이 사건 각 PC가 보관된 장소인 강사휴게실이 피고인의 professor research room 주변에 있었다는 점 등 피고인이 주장하는 모든 circumstances를 고려해 보더라도, 피고인의 이 사건 각 PC에 대한 actual domination·management state와 이에 저장된 electronic information 전반에 관한 management/disposition right가 이 사건 압수·수색 당시까지 maintained되고 있었다고 볼 수 없으므로, 피고인을 이 사건 압수·수색에 관하여 substantial person subject to seizure로 evaluate할 수 있는 경우에 해당하지 아니한다.
따라서 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information의 seizure·search는 위 대법원 2016도348 전원합의체 판결이 설시한 legal principles에 따르더라도 suspect에게 participation right를 guarantee하여야 하는 경우에는 해당하지 아니한다.
(라) 한편 피고인은 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information의 seizure·search process에서 피고인 측을 electronic information의 ‘data subject’라고 하면서 이를 basis로 피고인 측에게 participation right가 guaranteed되었어야 한다는 purport의 주장도 한다. 앞서 본 바와 같이, suspect의 involvement 없이 voluntarily submitted된 information storage medium 내의 electronic information search 등 process에서 suspect가 participation right를 assert하기 위해서는 information storage medium에 대한 actual domination·management state와 그 내부 electronic information 전반에 관한 exclusive management/disposition right의 possession이 premise되어야 한다. Therefore 이러한 domination·management 등의 state와 unrelated하게 individual electronic information의 creation·use 등에 관여한 자들 혹은 그 process에서 generated된 electronic information에 의해 identified되는 사람으로서 그 information의 subject가 되는 사람들에게까지 모두 participation right를 인정하는 purport가 아니므로, 위 주장 cannot be accepted.
(마) 결국 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information에 대한 search 및 extraction 등 process에서 피압수자 측에게는 participation right가 guaranteed되었고, 이에 더하여 피고인 측의 participation right까지 보장되어야 하는 case에는 해당하지 아니하므로, 원심판단의 이 부분 잘못 역시 judgment result에 influence가 없다.
(4) 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 electronic information의 evidence admissibility
원심은 판시와 같은 이유를 들어 검찰이 이 사건 각 PC의 possession·custody자인 ○○대 측으로부터 위 각 PC를 voluntarily received하여 seized한 것은 unlawful investigation after indictment에 해당하지 않고, 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 electronic information에 관하여 피고인 측의 consent를 받아야만 그 evidence admissibility가 인정된다고 할 수 없으며, 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 electronic information 및 그 outputted documents와 original과의 identity·integrity가 proven되었다고 보아 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 electronic information이 evidence로 used될 수 있다고 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 앞서 본 legal principles와 위 인정 사실에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 이유 설시에 일부 inappropriate한 부분이 있으나 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 evidence의 evidence admissibility를 인정한 원심의 conclusion은 proper하고, grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 공소제기 후 강제수사, third party consent에 의한 voluntarily submitted items의 seizure·search에 있어서 data subject의 consent의 necessity, voluntarily submitted items의 seizure에 있어서 custodian의 status 및 voluntariness, information storage medium에 대한 voluntarily submitted items seizure에 있어서 형사소송법 제219조 준용규정의 scope, original과의 identity·integrity, warrant requirement 등에 관한 legal principles를 misapprehend하여 judgment에 영향을 미친 wrong이 없다.
2) financial account tracing용 seizure·search warrant execution result의 evidence admissibility
가) 원심은 판시와 같은 reason을 들어 financial account tracing용 seizure·search warrant의 execution에 있어서 검찰이 형사사법정보통신망을 통해 여러 financial institutions에 금융거래정보 제공요구서, 영장 사본 및 수사관 신분증 사본을 electronic fax 방식으로 송신하고 금융기관으로부터 email이나 fax로 금융거래자료를 수신하여, 수신한 금융거래자료를 analyze한 후 final로 사건과 관련된 selected data list를 작성한 다음 금융기관에 직접 방문하여 영장 원본을 제시하고 선별자료를 storage medium에 저장하는 한편 seizure inventory를 delivered하고 seizure protocol를 작성하는 일련의 execution methods는 헌법과 형사소송법이 정한 seizure·search procedure에 violate되지 아니하고, 이 사건에서 그러한 방법으로 수집되어 evidence로 submitted된 금융거래자료는 evidence admissibility가 있다고 판단하였다.
나) 그러나 수사기관의 seizure·search는 법관이 발부한 seizure·search warrant에 의하여야 하는 것이 원칙이고, 영장의 original은 처분을 받는 자에게 반드시 제시되어야 하므로(대법원 2017. 9. 7. 선고 2015도10648 판결, 대법원 2019. 3. 14. 선고 2018도2841 판결 등 참조), financial account tracing용 seizure·search warrant의 execution에 있어서도 수사기관이 금융기관으로부터 금융거래자료를 수신하기에 앞서 금융기관에 warrant original을 prior하게 제시하지 않았다면 원칙적으로 lawful execution method라고 볼 수는 없다.
다만 수사기관이 금융기관에 「금융실명거래 및 비밀보장에 관한 법률」(이하 ‘금융실명법’이라 한다) 제4조 제2항에 따라서 금융거래정보에 대하여 warrant copy를 attached하여 그 제공을 요구한 결과 금융기관으로부터 replied받은 금융거래자료가 해당 warrant의 execution object and scope에 included되어 있고, 이러한 fax transmission 내지 electronic transmission 방식의 금융거래정보 제공요구 및 자료 회신의 전 과정이 해당 금융기관의 voluntary cooperation intention에 따른 것이며, 그 자료 중 criminal suspicion facts와 related된 금융거래를 select하는 procedure를 거친 후 final로 warrant original을 제시하고 위와 같이 selected된 금융거래자료에 대한 seizure procedure가 executed된 경우로서, 그 process가 금융실명법에서 정한 방식에 따라 이루어지고 달리 due process와 warrant principle을 잠탈하기 위한 intent에서 이루어진 것이라고 볼 만한 circumstances가 없어, 이러한 series of processes를 전체적으로 ‘하나의 영장에 기하여 timely하게 original을 제시하고 이를 토대로 seizure·search하는 것’으로 evaluate할 수 있는 경우에 한하여, exceptionally warrant의 lawful execution method에 해당한다고 볼 수 있다.
다) 이러한 legal principles에 비추어 이 사건 각 financial account tracing용 seizure·search warrant의 execution process를 살펴보면, 수사기관이 금융기관으로부터 금융거래자료를 수신하기에 앞서 warrant original을 prior하게 제시하지 않았다고 하더라도 그 후 criminal suspicion facts와 related된 자료의 selection procedure를 거친 후 final로 warrant original을 제시하고 그 selected 자료를 directly seize하는 일련의 process가 전체적으로 하나의 영장에 기하여 timely하게 original을 제시하고 이를 토대로 영장의 당초 execution object and scope 내에서 이를 seize·search한 것으로 evaluate할 수 있는 case에 해당하고, 수사기관이 due process와 warrant principle을 잠탈하려는 intent에서 위와 같은 method로 executed하였다고 인정할 만한 circumstances도 보이지 아니한다.
따라서 이 사건 각 financial account tracing용 seizure·search warrant의 execution process에서 secured된 financial transaction data의 evidence admissibility가 인정된다고 한 원심의 conclusion은 proper하고, grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 warrant presentation method 및 seizure·search procedure의 lawfulness, 이 부분 seizure items 및 secondary evidence의 evidence admissibility에 관한 legal principle misapprehension, 심리미진 등으로 judgment에 영향을 미친 wrong이 없다.
3) (회사명 1 생략) 실물주권 12만 주
원심은 판시와 같은 reason을 들어 (회사명 1 생략) 실물주권 12만 주에 관한 seizure·search warrant가 피압수자에게 lawful하게 presented되었고, seizure의 necessity와 criminal suspicion facts와의 relevance도 recognized되므로 evidence admissibility가 있다고 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 related legal principles와 적법하게 채택한 evidence에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 이 부분 seizure items 및 secondary evidence의 evidence admissibility에 관한 legal principle misapprehension, 심리미진 등의 wrong이 없다.
4) (회사명 2 생략) 보관 통화 녹음파일의 evidence admissibility
원심은 판시와 같은 reason을 들어 (회사명 2 생략) 보관 통화 녹음파일에 관하여 seizure의 necessity와 criminal suspicion facts와의 relevance가 recognized되므로 evidence admissibility가 있다고 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 related legal principles와 적법하게 채택한 evidence에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 이 부분 seizure items 및 secondary evidence의 evidence admissibility에 관한 legal principle misapprehension, 심리미진 등의 wrong이 없다.
나. 공소외 1의 medical graduate school fraudulent application related offenses에 관한 grounds of appeal에 대하여
원심은 판시와 같은 reason을 들어 이 부분 공소사실(업무방해, 위계공무집행방해, ▽▽대 ◎◎◎◎연구소장 명의 체험활동 확인서에 관한 허위작성공문서행사, △△대 ◁대 ▷▷▷▷▷센터장 명의 인턴십 확인서에 관한 예비적 공소사실인 허위작성공문서행사, 2013. 6. 16. 사문서위조, 위조사문서행사) 기재와 같이 피고인이 ○○대 총장 명의 표창장을 위조하였고 나머지 각 증빙서류도 모두 허위이며, 이를 공소외 1의 △△대 및 □□대 의학전문대학원 지원 과정에서 제출하거나 경력에 기재하는 것은 업무방해죄 및 위계공무집행방해죄의 위계에 해당하고, 그 과정에서 피고인의 고의와 공소외 1 등과의 공모관계가 인정되며, 이는 각 의학전문대학원의 입학사정 업무를 방해하는 행위로서 업무 담당자의 불충분한 심사에 의한 것이라고 볼 수 없다고 보아 이 부분 공소사실을 guilty로 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 related legal principles와 적법하게 채택한 evidence에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 logic과 experience의 법칙을 위반하여 free evaluation of evidence의 limits를 벗어나거나 공동정범의 성립, 업무방해죄 및 위계공무집행방해죄의 ‘위계’ 및 ‘고의’, 방해의 ‘위험성’ 등에 관한 legal principle misapprehension, 판단누락, 심리미진 등의 wrong이 없다.
다. 사기 및 구「보조금 관리에 관한 법률」(2016. 1. 28. 법률 제13931호로 개정되기 전의 것, 이하 ‘구 보조금법’이라 한다) 위반 부분에 관한 grounds of appeal에 대하여
원심은 판시와 같은 reason을 들어 이 부분 공소사실 기재 special grant money는 구 보조금법상 subsidy에 해당하고, 피고인이 허위로 research assistant allowance를 신청하여 이를 지급받은 것으로 인정되므로 사기죄의 deception act에 해당한다고 보아 이 부분 공소사실을 guilty로 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 related legal principles와 적법하게 채택한 evidence에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 logic과 experience의 법칙을 위반하여 free evaluation of evidence의 limits를 벗어나거나 구 보조금법 제2조 제1호, 제9조, 같은 법 시행령 제4조 제1항 [별표 1]의 interpretation, 사기죄의 deception에 관한 legal principle misapprehension, 심리미진 등의 wrong이 없다.
라. 미공개중요정보 이용으로 인한「자본시장과 금융투자업에 관한 법률」(이하 ‘자본시장법’이라 한다) 위반 부분(이유 무죄 부분 제외)에 관한 grounds of appeal에 대하여
원심은 판시와 같은 reason을 들어 이 부분 공소사실 기재와 같이 피고인이 미공개중요정보를 이용하여 (회사명 1 생략) 주식을 매수한 사실이 recognized된다고 보아 이 부분 공소사실을 guilty로 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 related legal principles와 적법하게 채택한 evidence에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 logic과 experience의 법칙을 위반하여 free evaluation of evidence의 limits를 벗어나거나 미공개중요정보 이용행위의 성립, presumption of innocence principle에 관한 legal principle misapprehension, 심리미진, 이유불비 등의 wrong이 없다.
마. 금융실명법 위반 부분(무죄 부분 제외)에 관한 grounds of appeal에 대하여
원심은 판시와 같은 reason을 들어 피고인이 탈법행위를 목적으로 이 부분 공소사실 기재 각 계좌를 borrowed하여 자신의 계산으로 금융거래를 한 사실이 recognized된다고 보아 이 부분 공소사실을 guilty로 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 related legal principles와 적법하게 채택한 evidence에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 logic과 experience의 법칙을 위반하여 free evaluation of evidence의 limits를 벗어나거나 금융실명법 위반죄의 ‘탈법 목적’에 관한 legal principle misapprehension, 심리미진 등의 wrong이 없다.
바. 증거인멸교사 부분에 관한 grounds of appeal에 대하여
원심은 판시와 같은 reason을 들어 피고인이 이 부분 공소사실 기재와 같이 공소외 3 또는 피고인의 형사사건 등에 관한 evidence인 공소외 5 관련 자료를 인멸하려는 intent를 가지고, 공소외 6, 공소외 7과 공모하여 (회사명 3 생략) employees에 대한 증거인멸교사가 이루어지도록 하였으며, 이에 대한 공동가공의 의사와 functional control over the act가 recognized되고, 이러한 피고인의 행위는 defense right abuse에 해당한다고 보아 이 부분 공소사실을 guilty로 판단하였다.

2. 검사의 grounds of appeal에 대하여
원심은 판시와 같은 reason으로 이 사건 공소사실 중 △△대 ◁대 ▷▷▷▷▷센터장 명의 인턴십 확인서에 관한 주위적 공소사실인 위조공문서행사, 업무상횡령, (회사명 1 생략) 실물주권 12만 주 장외매수에 관한 미공개중요정보 이용으로 인한 자본시장법 위반 및「범죄수익은닉의 규제 및 처벌 등에 관한 법률」위반, 거짓 변경보고로 인한 자본시장법 위반, (회사명 2 생략) 계좌(계좌번호 생략)를 이용한 금융실명법 위반, 증거위조교사 부분에 대하여 범죄의 증명이 없다고 보아 이를 무죄로 판단하거나 무죄를 선고한 제1심판결을 그대로 유지하였다.
원심판결 이유를 related legal principles와 record에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 logic과 experience의 법칙을 위반하여 free evaluation of evidence의 limits를 벗어나거나, 위조공문서행사죄의 intent, 업무상횡령죄의 불법영득의사, 미공개중요정보 이용으로 인한 자본시장법 위반죄의 establishment, 공동정범의 establishment, 금융실명법 위반죄의 ‘탈법 목적’, 교사행위에 관한 legal principle misapprehension, 판단누락 등의 wrong이 없다.
3. 결론
그러므로 all appeals를 dismiss하기로 하여, 관여 대법관의 일치된 opinion으로 주문과 같이 판결한다."}

가. relevant legal principles
1) information storage medium 내의 electronic information가 가지는 importance는 Constitution과 Criminal Procedure Act가 구현하고자 하는 due process, warrant requirement, proportionality principle과 함께 privacy의 secrecy and freedom, information self-determination right 등의 perspectives에서 derived된다.
압수의 대상이 되는 electronic information와 그렇지 않은 electronic information이 intermingled된 information storage medium나 그 duplicate를 voluntary submission 받은 law enforcement agency가 그 information storage medium 등을 agency office 등으로 옮겨 이를 search, copy, print하는 경우, 그와 같은 일련의 process에서 Criminal Procedure Act Articles 219, 121에서 규정하는 seizure and search warrant의 execution을 받는 party(이하 ‘person subject to seizure’라 한다)나 그 counsel에게 opportunity to participate를 guarantee하고 seized electronic information의 file details가 specified된 seizure inventory를 prepare and deliver하여야 하며, crime suspicion facts와 unrelated한 electronic information의 arbitrary copying 등을 막기 위한 appropriate measures를 take하는 등 warrant requirement principle과 due process를 comply하여야 한다. If such measures were not taken, then the person subject to seizure side가 participate하지 않겠다는 intention을 expressly 표시하였거나 voluntary submission의 purport와 course 또는 그 procedure violation이 이루어진 process의 nature and content 등에 비추어 person subject to seizure side에게 procedure participation을 guarantee한 purport가 substantially infringed되었다고 볼 수 없을 정도라는 special circumstance가 없는 이상 seizure and search는 lawful하다고 평가할 수 없고, 비록 law enforcement agency가 information storage medium 또는 duplicate에서 crime suspicion facts와 related된 electronic information만을 copy, print하였다고 하더라도 달리 볼 것은 아니다.
victim 등 third party가 suspect의 possession and control에 속하는 information storage medium를 voluntary submission한 경우에는 substantive person subject to seizure인 suspect가 law enforcement agency로 하여금 그 electronic information 전부를 unrestricted하게 search하는 데 consent한 것으로 보기 어려울 뿐만 아니라 suspect himself/herself가 voluntary submission한 경우 suspect의 participation right 등이 guaranteed되어야 하는 것과 compare해 보더라도 special circumstance가 없는 한 suspect에게 participation right를 guarantee하고 seized electronic information inventory를 deliver하는 등 suspect의 procedural rights를 guarantee하기 위한 appropriate measures가 taken되어야 한다(see Supreme Court 2021. 11. 18. decision 2016DO348 en banc etc.).
2) 이와 같이 information storage medium를 voluntary submission한 person subject to seizure에 더하여 voluntary submitter 아닌 suspect에게도 participation right가 guaranteed되어야 하는 ‘information storage medium belonging to or under the control of the suspect’라 함은, suspect가 seizure and search at the time or at a temporally close point thereto까지 해당 information storage medium를 actually dominate and control하면서 그 information storage medium 내 electronic information 전반에 관한 exclusive management and disposition authority를 possess and exercise하고, 달리 이를 자신의 intention에 따라 third party에게 transfer하거나 abandon하지 아니한 case로서, suspect를 그 information storage medium에 stored된 electronic information 전반에 대한 substantial seizure and search party로 evaluate할 수 있는 case를 말한다. Whether this applies shall be determined not on the basis of a legal judgment following civil law rights attribution, but on the basis of the factual condition outwardly and objectively recognizable at the time of seizure and search. Apart from such outward and objective state of domination and control over the information storage medium etc., it is not the case that they must be treated as substantial seizure and search parties merely because suspect or another third party had in the past been involved in the use of the information storage medium or in the creation or use of individual electronic information, or because they correspond to the data subject identified by electronic information created in that process(see Supreme Court 2022. 1. 27. decision 2021DO11170 etc.).
나. found facts
원심판결 이유 및 적법하게 admitted된 evidence에 의하면 다음의 facts를 알 수 있다.
1) law enforcement agency는 2019. 8. 27.경 공소외 1, 공소외 2의 children admission and academic irregularities suspicion, private equity fund investment impropriety suspicion, (명칭 1 생략) academy impropriety suspicion 등과 관련된 (명칭 2 생략) University, (명칭 3 생략) office, (명칭 1 생략) academy 등에 대한 seizure and search를 start로 각종 allegations에 대한 investigation을 full-scale로 하였다.
2) 공소외 1은 seizure and search 등 investigation에 대비하여 crime suspicion facts와 related된 electronic information가 stored된 computers etc.를 conceal하기 위하여, 2019. 8. 31.경 공소외 3에게 study에 있던 computer에서 detached한 information storage medium 2개 중 1개(HDD 1개), son 공소외 4의 computer에서 detached한 information storage medium 2개(HDD 1개, SSD 1개) 등 공소외 1, 공소외 2, 공소외 4(이하 ‘공소외 1 등’이라 한다)가 residence에서 used하던 3개의 information storage medium(이하 ‘이 사건 hard disk’라 한다)를 hand over하면서 “until investigation is over”라는 purport로 hide하라고 instructed하였다. 공소외 3은 이 사건 hard disk를 Seoul Yangcheon-gu 소재 commercial building basement level 1 gym personal locker 등에 hidden해 두었다.
3) 이 사건 hard disk에는 공소외 1이 conceal하고자 했던 evidence, 즉 children의 university and graduate school admission에 utilized한 internship certificates 및 공소외 4, defendant 등 related persons의 text messages 등이 stored되어 있었다.
4) law enforcement agency는 2019. 9. 10.경 공소외 3을 evidence concealment suspicion suspect로 registered하였다. 공소외 3은 2019. 9. 11. law enforcement agency에 이 사건 hard disk를 voluntary submission하였다.
5) law enforcement agency는 이 사건 hard disk voluntary submission 및 그에 stored된 electronic information에 관한 search, copy, print process에서 공소외 3과 그 counsel에게 participation intention을 confirm하고 participation opportunity를 give하는 등 participation right를 guarantee하였는데 공소외 3 side는 search, copy, print process에 participate하지 않겠다는 intention을 밝혔다. law enforcement agency는 공소외 1 등에게는 위와 같은 participation intention을 confirm하거나 participation opportunity를 give하지 않았다.
다. judgment
앞서 살펴본 legal principles와 위 found facts에서 알 수 있는 다음 circumstances를 종합하면, 증거은닉범행의 suspect로서 이 사건 hard disk를 voluntary submission한 공소외 3에 더하여 voluntary submitter가 아닌 공소외 1 등에게도 participation right가 guaranteed되어야 한다고 볼 수 없다. 같은 purport에서 이 사건 hard disk에 stored된 electronic information의 evidentiary capacity를 인정한 lower court의 judgment는 justifiable하고 can be accepted.
1) 공소외 3은 voluntary submission의 cause가 된 crime suspicion fact인 evidence concealment offense의 suspect로서 자신에 대한 investigation process에서 이 사건 hard disk를 voluntary submission하였다. 이 사건 hard disk 및 그에 stored된 electronic information은 principal offense인 공소외 1 등의 suspicion facts에 관한 evidence이기도 하지만 동시에 concealment act의 direct object이므로 공소외 3의 evidence concealment suspicion facts에 관한 evidence이기도 하다. Accordingly, 공소외 3은 이 사건 hard disk와 그에 stored된 electronic information에 관하여 substantial interest가 있는 person에 해당한다. 이 사건 hard disk itself의 voluntary submission을 비롯하여 evidence concealment suspicion facts related electronic information의 search, copy, print process 전체에 걸쳐 공소외 3은 participation interest가 있다.
2) 공소외 1은 자신과 공소외 2 등에 대한 investigation이 full-scale화되자 공소외 3에게 concealment를 instructed하면서 이 사건 hard disk를 delivered하였다. 공소외 3은 이 사건 hard disk가 발견되지 않도록 자신만이 아는 place에 arbitrarily concealed하였다. Thereafter, 공소외 3은 evidence concealment suspicion에 관한 suspect로 registered되자 law enforcement agency에 concealment fact를 밝히면서 이 사건 hard disk를 voluntary submission하였다. 이 사건 hard disk의 concealment and voluntary submission course, 그 process에서 공소외 3과 공소외 1 등의 involvement degree 등에 비추어 seizure and search at the time or at a time close thereto에 이 사건 hard disk를 actually possessed한 person은 공소외 3이라고 할 것이다. Further, 공소외 3이 그 무렵 위와 같은 course로 이 사건 hard disk를 actually possessed한 이상 다른 special circumstance가 없는 한 stored된 electronic information에 관한 management and disposition authority를 de facto possess and exercise할 수 있는 status에 있는 person도 공소외 3이라고 볼 수 있다.
3) 공소외 1은 voluntary submission의 cause가 된 crime suspicion fact인 evidence concealment offense의 suspect가 아닐 뿐만 아니라 이 사건 hard disk의 existence itself를 conceal할 purpose로 vaguely ‘자신에 대한 investigation이 끝날 때까지’ hide해 달라고 부탁하며 이 사건 hard disk를 공소외 3에게 deliver하였다. 이는 자신과 이 사건 hard disk 및 그에 stored된 electronic information 사이의 outward connection을 conceal and sever하겠다는 purpose 아래 그 purpose accomplishment에 need하다면 ‘investigation completion’이라는 indefinite time까지 이 사건 hard disk에 관한 exclusive domination and control right를 abandon하거나 공소외 3에게 wholly transfer한다는 intention을 express한 것으로 볼 수 있다. Thereby 결과적으로 공소외 3은 이 사건 hard disk에 대한 actual and factual domination 및 그에 stored된 electronic information 전반에 관한 exclusive management and disposition authority를 de facto possess and exercise할 수 있는 state가 되었고, 자신이 arbitrarily chosen place에 이 사건 hard disk를 conceal하였다가 thereafter 이를 law enforcement agency에 voluntary submission함으로써 그 authority를 actually exercised하였다.
2. other grounds for final appeal judgment
원심은 판시와 같은 reason으로 이 사건 공소사실을 guilty로 판단한 first-instance judgment를 그대로 maintained하였다. 원심판결 reason을 related legal principles와 적법하게 adopted한 evidence에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 필요한 심리를 다하지 않은 채 logic and experience rules를 violated하여 free evaluation of evidence limits를 벗어나거나 seized items와 defendant facts 사이의 relation, abuse of prosecutorial authority, the presumption of innocence and evidence-based trial principle concerning the falsity of the instant certificate, deception and result occurrence risk in business obstruction crime, intent and co-principal, derivative evidence admissibility 등에 관한 legal principles를 misunderstood하여 judgment에 affected된 error가 없다.
3. conclusion
그러므로 final appeal을 dismiss하기로 하여 main text와 같이 judgment한다. 이 judgment에는 Supreme Court Justice Min Yu-sook, Justice Lee Heung-gu, Justice Oh Kyung-mi의 dissenting opinion이 있는 외에는 participating Justices의 opinions가 unified되었고, majority opinion에 대한 Justice Ahn Cheol-sang, Justice Noh Tae-ak, Justice Cheon Dae-yeop의 supplementary opinion, 그리고 dissenting opinion에 대한 Justice Oh Kyung-mi의 supplementary opinion이 있다.
4. dissenting opinion of Supreme Court Justices Min Yu-sook, Lee Heung-gu, and Oh Kyung-mi
가. summary of dissenting opinion
1) majority opinion은 이 사건 hard disk의 voluntary submitter인 공소외 3이 증거은닉범행의 suspect로서 그에 stored된 electronic information에 관하여 substantial interest가 있고 이를 actually possessed함으로써 해당 electronic information에 관한 management and disposition authority를 de facto possess and exercise할 수 있는 status에 있으므로 seizure and search procedure에서 그에게 participation right를 guarantee한 것으로 sufficient하고, 자신의 suspicion facts에 관한 evidence를 conceal하기 위하여 공소외 3에게 이 사건 hard disk를 delivered한 공소외 1 등은 그에 대한 exclusive management and disposition authority를 abandon하거나 transferred한 이상 participation right guarantee의 대상자인 substantial person subject to seizure에 해당하지 않는다고 판단하였다.
2) However, 이에 동의할 수 없다. majority opinion은 participation right를 guaranteed받는 subject인 ‘substantial person subject to seizure’를 seizure and search의 cause가 된 crime suspicion facts의 suspect를 중심으로 narrow하게 파악하는 것으로서 precedents의 purport and direction에 accord하지 않는다. 또 majority opinion에 의하면 modern society의 individual and enterprise에 increasingly important meaning을 갖는 electronic information에 관한 law enforcement agency의 coercive disposition에서 due process와 warrant requirement를 realize해야 하는 constitutional demand를 외면함으로써 substantial person subject to seizure인 electronic information manager/disposer의 privacy secrecy and freedom 등에 관한 fundamental rights가 infringed되는 anti-constitutional result를 allow하게 된다.
3) 위 Supreme Court en banc 2016DO348 decision(이하 ‘2016DO348 en banc decision’이라 한다) 및 Supreme Court 2021DO11170 decision etc.에서 Supreme Court는 electronic information의 seizure and search에서 participation right가 guaranteed되는 subject인 substantial person subject to seizure는 해당 information storage medium를 actually dominate and control하면서 그 information storage medium 내 electronic information 전반에 관한 exclusive management and disposition authority를 possess and exercise하는 person으로서 그에 대한 substantial seizure and search party로 evaluate할 수 있는 person이라고 하였다. 이러한 precedents의 legal principles와 purport에 따르면, coercive disposition의 direct party이자 formal person subject to seizure인 information storage medium의 actual possessor/custodian 외에 owner/manager가 separately exist하고, coercive disposition에 의하여 그의 electronic information에 대한 privacy secrecy and freedom, information self-determination right, property right 등을 infringed받을 우려가 있는 경우, 그 owner/manager는 participation right guarantee의 object인 substantial person subject to seizure라고 보아야 한다. 이때 substantial person subject to seizure가 seizure and search의 cause가 된 crime suspicion facts의 suspect일 것을 require하는 것은 아니다.
4) 따라서 증거은닉범이 principal offender로부터 evidence concealment를 instructed받아 possessed and kept하고 있던 principal offender-owned/controlled information storage medium를 suspect status에서 law enforcement agency에 voluntary submission하였고, principal offender가 그 information storage medium에 stored된 electronic information의 search, copy, print 시 privacy secrecy and freedom 등을 infringed받지 않을 substantial benefit를 갖는다고 evaluate될 수 있는 경우, voluntary submitter이자 suspect인 증거은닉범과 함께 그러한 substantial interest를 갖는 principal offender에게도 participation right가 guaranteed되어야 한다.
이러한 point에서 majority opinion과 view를 달리한다. 그 detailed grounds는 다음과 같다.
나. the purpose of guaranteeing participation rights in electronic information seizure and search and the concretization of participation right
precedent의 electronic information seizure and search에서 participation right doctrine은 State coercive disposition의 direct object가 된 person subject to seizure를 center로 하여 coercive disposition으로 basic rights 등이 actually infringed되는 person, 즉 seizure and search disposition의 substantial party를 protect하기 위한 direction으로 evolved하였다.
1) Supreme Court는 early on 2011. 5. 26. decision 2009MO1190으로 National Teachers Union office에 있는 information storage medium에 대한 seizure and search에서 coercive disposition의 object가 된 person subject to seizure 또는 그 counsel에 대하여 participation right를 guarantee하는 legal doctrine을 first time set forth하였다. 이어 Supreme Court 2015. 7. 16. decision 2011MO1839 en banc를 통해 Kyungdong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.에 대한 seizure and search에서 coercive disposition의 subject인 person subject to seizure를 center로 한 participation right guarantee doctrine을 reaffirm하면서, person subject to seizure의 participation right를 excluded한 procedural illegality가 있을 때 principle로 evidentiary capacity가 excluded됨을 declared하였다.
위 Supreme Court decisions 2009MO1190 and 2011MO1839 en banc에서 Supreme Court는 National Teachers Union과 Kyungdong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.가 suspect status에 있지 않았지만 law enforcement agency의 seizure and search로부터 electronic information에 대한 self-determination right, property right 등을 infringed받지 않을 substantial interest를 갖는 person subject to seizure status에 있음을 emphasized하여, 이들을 participation right의 attribution subject로 인정하였다. Thereafter, Supreme Court는 person subject to seizure와 suspect가 동일인인 various cases에서 information storage medium에 대한 seizure and search disposition의 object인 person subject to seizure에게 participation right를 인정하였고(see Supreme Court 2017. 9. 21. decision 2015DO12400, 2017. 11. 14. decision 2017DO3449, 2019. 7. 11. decision 2018DO20504 etc.), finally 2016DO348 en banc decision을 통해 person subject to seizure와 suspect가 동일인이 아닌 case에서 third party를 person subject to seizure로 하여 suspect-owned/controlled information storage medium에 대한 coercive disposition이 이루어질 때 substantial person subject to seizure인 suspect에게 participation right를 guarantee하고 seized electronic information inventory를 deliver하는 등 appropriate measures가 taken되어야 한다고 하여, participation right의 guarantee subject를 substantial person subject to seizure에까지 expanded하였다. Supreme Court 2022. 5. 31. decision 2016MO587에서 law enforcement agency가 internet service company Kakao Corp.를 person subject to seizure로 하여 그 server에 stored되어 있는 service user(suspect)의 KakaoTalk conversation contents etc.에 대하여 seizure and search를 실시하는 process에서 service user에게 participation right attribution subject인 substantial person subject to seizure status를 recognized하였다. Meanwhile, 위 Supreme Court 2021DO11170 decision에서는 suspect가 used하던 information storage medium를 third party가 law enforcement agency에 voluntary submission한 경우 그 management and disposition authority가 third party에게 transferred된 것으로 볼 수 있다면 suspect가 아닌 third party(voluntary submitter)에게 participation opportunity를 give한 것으로 sufficient하다고 하였다.
2) 이와 같이 Supreme Court가 electronic information의 seizure and search procedure에서 ‘person subject to seizure’를 center로 participation right concept를 establish하고 substantial person subject to seizure에까지 그 attribution subject를 expand한 것은, today companies or individuals의 business에 widely used되는 large-capacity computers or servers etc. information processing systems, smartphones etc. information storage medium에는 crime suspicion과 unrelated한 individual daily life or corporate management 관한 electronic information(이하 ‘irrelevant information’이라 한다)이 압수 대상인 suspected facts에 관한 electronic information(이하 ‘relevant information’이라 한다)과 함께 extensively intermingled되어 있어, 이와 관련한 개인과 기업의 privacy secrecy and freedom, information self-determination right, property right etc. legal interests를 protect하기 위하여 그에 대한 seizure and search 등의 coercive disposition을 하는 law enforcement agency가 irrelevant information까지 search, copy, print하지 않도록 할 procedural measures가 urgently needed하다는 constitutional demand에 response한 result이다.
이러한 purport에서 Supreme Court는 suspect가 소유·관리하는 information storage medium를 third party가 voluntary submission하는 경우 “information storage medium에는 그의 privacy secrecy and freedom, information self-determination right 등 personality-related legal interests에 관한 모든 것이 stored되어 있어, voluntary submission의 subject가 owner 아닌 possessor/custodian에 불과함에도 아무런 restriction 없이 seizure and search가 allowed되면 suspect의 personality-related legal interests가 substantially infringed될 우려가 있음을 고려하여, 그 submission act로 owner의 privacy secrecy 기타 personality-related legal interests가 substantially infringed될 우려가 있는 경우에는 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure and search의 necessity와 함께 voluntary submission에 동의하지 않은 owner의 legal interests에 대한 special consideration도 필요하기 때문”에 압수의 대상을 relevant information으로 더욱 limited하여 interpret하여야 한다고 declared하였다(2016DO348 en banc decision, Supreme Court 2021. 11. 25. decision 2019DO7342 etc. 참조).
다. the meaning of the substantial person subject to seizure who is the subject to whom the participation right belongs and the criteria for determining it
전자정보의 seizure and search에서 participation right의 attribution subject가 되는 substantial person subject to seizure는 seizure and search at the time까지 해당 information storage medium를 dominate and manage하면서 information storage medium 내 electronic information 전반에 관한 exclusive management and disposition authority를 possess and exercise하는 person으로서, information storage medium에 lawful seizure의 object가 되는 electronic information과 함께 intermingled되어 있는 irrelevant information에 대한 law enforcement agency의 search and print 등을 exclude할 privacy secrecy 기타 personality-related legal interests를 가진 person이라고 보아야 한다.
1) Participation right of the person subject to seizure, who is the object of coercive disposition
participation right의 attribution subject는 coercive disposition의 object가 된 information storage medium etc.의 actual possessor/custodian이자 stored electronic information의 manager and disposer로서 coercive disposition의 substantial counterpart인 것으로 sufficient하고, 압수·수색의 cause가 된 crime suspicion facts의 suspect일 것까지 require하는 것은 아니다.
가) Korean Constitution은 “no one shall be subjected to … seizure or search … except by due process of law”(Article 12(1) final sentence), “when arresting, detaining, seizing, or searching, a warrant issued by a judge upon the request of a prosecutor in accordance with due process of law shall be presented”(Article 12(3) main text)라고 정하여 seizure and search에 관한 due process와 warrant requirement principle을 declared하고 있다. 형사소송법은 due process와 warrant requirement를 concretely realize하기 위하여 seizure and search warrant 발부 방식, execution procedure에서 warrant presentation, party participation 및 participation right holder에 대한 prior notice, responsible person participation 등 law enforcement agency의 seizure and search procedure를 limit하는 detailed provisions를 마련하고 있다(Articles 219, 114, 118, 121, 122, 123). 특히 Article 215(1)는 “when necessary for criminal investigation, a prosecutor may, only insofar as there are circumstances from which the suspect may be deemed to have committed a crime and only with respect to those recognized as related to the relevant case, conduct seizure, search, or inspection by a warrant issued upon application to a judge of a district court”라고 하여 so-called relevance principle을 established하였다.
Supreme Court는 relevant information과 irrelevant information이 intermingled된 digital storage medium seizure and search의 특수성에 주목하여 irrelevant information의 unlawful searching and collecting을 effectively curb함으로써 Constitution and Criminal Procedure Act의 normative force를 firmly uphold하고자, Article 12 of Constitution concerning due process and warrant requirement together with the fundamental purport of various procedural provisions of Criminal Procedure Act, including those providing for “suspect and his/her defense counsel” participation in seizure and search procedure and stating that “with respect to seized items, appropriate measures shall be taken to prevent their loss, damage, etc.”(Articles 219, 121, 131), looked into and established the doctrine that “person subject to seizure and his/her defense counsel” may participate in electronic information seizure and search procedure and expanded the scope of such guarantee to the “substantial person subject to seizure.”
Supreme Court는 even before the enactment of Article 243-2 of Criminal Procedure Act, which provides for defense counsel’s right to participate, in suspect interrogation procedure under former Criminal Procedure Act(where there was no express provision concerning defense counsel’s right to participate), recognized defense counsel’s right to participate by analogically applying the former Criminal Procedure Act provisions concerning detention-bound defendants or suspects’ meeting and communication rights, based on the constitutional principle of due process(see Supreme Court 2003. 11. 11. decision 2003MO402). Recognizing person subject to seizure’s participation right in electronic information seizure and search procedure and extending it to substantial person subject to seizure is an extension of Supreme Court’s stance to date of interpreting Criminal Procedure Act in conformity with Constitution so as to protect the basic human rights of the subject of State coercive disposition from infringement.
나) Constitutional freedom of residence and privacy secrecy and freedom are guaranteed to everyone, and warrant requirement’s object is not limited to suspects(Constitution Articles 12, 16, 17); therefore, as the subject to whom participation right is attributed, the substantial person subject to seizure is not required to be in suspect status in the crime suspicion facts that caused the seizure and search. Just as in a typical seizure and search of residence or office, the substantive owner or manager of the residence etc. that became the object of coercive disposition is protected by privacy secrecy and freedom etc., in electronic information seizure and search procedure, the owner/manager of information storage medium etc., which is the object of coercive disposition, must receive procedural guarantees such as participation right in accordance with the warrant requirement principle. This is because, as owner/manager of the information storage medium, there is no reason to endure a State agency investigating the criminal suspicion of a third party(suspect) broadly searching, copying, and printing irrelevant information from his/her information storage medium merely because he/she is not the suspect. Permitting this would have the same result as permitting a general warrant.
다) According to precedents’ attitude regarding purpose and scope of recognition of participation right, in determining the subject to whom participation right belongs, it is not very important who submitted the relevant information storage medium to the law enforcement agency or whether that person is in suspect status. This is because, without needing to distinguish between the case where the manager/disposer of electronic information directly submits the information storage medium to the law enforcement agency and the case where a third party such as a victim possesses or keeps it for some reason and then submits it to the law enforcement agency, the necessity of guaranteeing participation rights to the person subject to seizure or the substantial person subject to seizure, who is the manager/disposer of the electronic information, in order to substantially protect his/her privacy secrecy and freedom and other personality-related legal interests, is the same.
The 2016DO348 en banc decision recognized the suspect’s participation right in the case where a victim or other third party unlawfully took a digital storage medium belonging to or under the control of the suspect and voluntary submitted it, because the suspect, as the owner/manager of the information storage medium and manager/disposer of the electronic information, occupies the status of the substantial object of the coercive disposition, that is, the ‘status of a person subject to seizure.’ The manager/disposer of irrelevant information existing within the information storage medium has an interest, as a substantial party to the seizure and search, in blocking the infringement of personality-related legal interests etc. arising from the coercive disposition even if that person is not the suspect. Conversely, even if one is a suspect, if one is not the manager/disposer, one does not have such an interest.
Supreme Court는 only in a case where the law enforcement agency received voluntary submission from a lodging business operator of a disguised camera etc. secretly installed in a guest room for illegal filming so as to photograph nudity or sexual acts, and did not afford the suspect who had secretly installed it an opportunity to participate, held that, due to the function and attributes of the relevant information storage medium, in cases where, from the perspective of the owner’s privacy secrecy and other personality-related legal interests, there is almost no room for electronic information subject to lawful seizure through voluntary submission and electronic information not subject to it to be intermingled and, in substance, most of the stored electronic information is that which is subject to seizure, the evidence should not be denied merely because the person subject to seizure other than the possessor/custodian was not guaranteed an opportunity to participate and no inventory of seized electronic information was prepared and delivered(see the above Supreme Court decision 2019DO7342). In the case of a digital storage medium storing only relevant information, there is in substance no risk of arbitrary searching and copying of irrelevant information, so there is no concern that the purport of guaranteeing participation rights will be undermined. The above Supreme Court decision confirmed that, in such a case, even the suspect, who is the manager/disposer of the electronic information, is not a subject to whom participation rights are guaranteed, thereby showing that the basis of the attribution of participation rights lies not in suspect status but in the status of being subject to coercive disposition such as seizure and search and thereby suffering substantial infringement of privacy and other personality-related legal interests.
라) In this way, in our criminal justice system and investigative practice, the person subject to seizure’s participation right guaranteed in the electronic information seizure and search procedure has become a practical yet essential procedural right and institution that can constitutionally control the coercive disposition of the law enforcement agency. By granting the person subjected to coercive disposition the opportunity to directly confirm on site the manner in which the seizure is executed and to raise objections, it is possible to effectively deter the searching and collecting of irrelevant information contrary to the warrant requirement.
