For the participation right to function substantially in accordance with its purpose, it is necessary to grant the participation right to the subject to whom the legal interests, such as privacy secrecy and freedom, that may be infringed by the search, copying, and printing of irrelevant information belong.
마) majority opinion이 이 사건 hard disk 및 그에 stored된 electronic information가 공소외 3의 증거은닉 suspicion facts에 관한 evidence라는 점을 basis로 하여, 공소외 3은 이 사건 hard disk와 그에 stored된 electronic information에 관하여 ‘substantial interest가 있는 자’에 해당하고 그 search, copy, print process 전체에 걸쳐 ‘participation interest’가 있으므로, 공소외 3에게 participation right를 guarantee한 이상 owner인 공소외 1 등의 participation이 없었더라도 seizure and search procedure가 lawful하다고 한 것은, participation right guarantee의 basis인 ‘electronic information에 관한 substantial interest’ 또는 ‘participation interest’를 suspect status 또는 crime suspicion facts와 ‘related된’ evidence에 대한 coercive disposition이라는 데에서 찾는 것이다. However, 이는 participation right guarantee의 basis와 그 object에 관한 precedents의 legal doctrine에 contrary하는 것으로서 improper하다. 앞서 살핀 바와 같이 precedents는 압수의 대상을 crime suspicion facts에 관한 electronic information으로 제한하고 그와 ‘unrelated’한 electronic information의 arbitrary copying 등을 막고자 participation right guarantee를 declared하였는바, precedents에 따른 participation interest는 ‘irrelevant evidence’에 관한 interest protection에 있다. 위 Supreme Court decision 2019DO7342 또한 ‘피의사실과 관련된’ electronic information, 즉 relevant information에 대한 interest만 있는 것은 ‘participation interest’로 보지 않았다.
majority opinion은 modern society에서 information storage medium 내 electronic information이 갖는 importance와 Constitution 및 Criminal Procedure Act가 구현하고자 하는 due process, warrant requirement principle과 함께 privacy secrecy and freedom, information self-determination right 등의 protection을 강조하면서도, participation right를 guaranteed받는 subject인 ‘substantial person subject to seizure’의 meaning을 seizure and search의 cause가 된 crime suspicion facts의 suspect를 중심으로 very narrowly interprets 하는 contradictory stance를 취하고 있다. 이로써 majority opinion은 그간 precedents가 electronic information에 관한 law enforcement agency의 coercive disposition에서 participation right guarantee doctrine을 declared하고 그 attribution subject scope를 expand하는 등 due process and warrant requirement principle을 realize해야 하는 constitutional demand에 respond하여 achieved한 outcomes를 substantially nullify하였다. As a result, electronic information seizure and search procedure에서 Supreme Court가 person subject to seizure or substantial person subject to seizure의 basic rights guarantee를 위해 opened한 participation right라는 procedural right의 door는 half-closed again 되었다. 강제처분의 direct and formal party인 suspect는 irrelevant information의 arbitrary search 등을 막을 special interest를 가지고 있지 않음에도 그에게 participation right를 guarantee하는 것만으로 sufficient하고 information storage medium의 owner/manager에게까지 participation right를 guarantee할 필요가 없다고 하는 것은, information storage medium의 seizure and search에서 relevance principle을 enforce하기 위한 appropriate measure가 될 수 없어 information storage medium의 owner/manager에게 발생할 수 있는 irrelevant information에 관한 personality-related legal interests infringement에 대하여 due process와 warrant requirement의 protection을 abandon하는 것이나 마찬가지이다.
2) guarantee of participation rights where formal person subject to seizure and substantial person subject to seizure are separate
law enforcement agency의 coercive disposition의 direct object가 된 formal person subject to seizure인 information storage medium의 actual possessor/custodian 외에 그 owner/manager가 separately exist하는 경우, 후자를 substantial person subject to seizure로 보아 그에게도 participation right를 guarantee할 필요가 있다.
가) technology development에 따라 information storage medium의 portability and mobility가 increased되면서 information storage medium의 actual possessor/custodian 외에 owner/manager가 separately exist하는 경우가 흔히 발생하게 되었다. First, information storage medium가 owner/manager의 intention과 무관하게 그에게서 leave하여 third party의 possession/custody 상태에 놓이게 되는 경우가 있다. owner/manager가 information storage medium를 lose하거나 theft, embezzlement of lost property 등의 criminal act의 object가 된 case, third party가 owner/manager의 consent 없이 information storage medium를 arbitrarily 가져가는 case 등이 이에 해당한다. On the other hand, owner/manager의 intention에 따라 formed된 possessory-mediated relationship를 기초로 information storage medium가 third party의 possession/custody 상태에 놓이게 되는 case도 있다. owner/manager가 전문수리점에 information storage medium의 repair를 request하거나 이를 bank 등의 paid safe에 deposit하는 case, child가 parent의 mobile phone을 temporarily borrow and use하는 case, owner/manager가 자신의 information storage medium를 living separately family member or acquaintance에게 맡겨 safekeeping하는 case 등일 것이다. The case where principal offender가 crime suspicion facts에 대한 evidence를 conceal하고자 자신이 owned and controlled하던 information storage medium를 evidence concealer에게 deliver하는 case도 owner/manager인 principal offender의 intention에 따라 formed된 possessory-mediated relationship를 기초로 한다는 점에서 latter category에 해당할 수 있다.
나) 2016DO348 en banc decision은 victim or other third party가 suspect의 knowledge 없이 suspect belonging to or under the control of information storage medium를 crime scene에서 가지고 나와 law enforcement agency에 voluntary submission한 case, 즉 information storage medium가 owner/manager의 intention과 무관하게 그의 possession에서 leave한 former situation에서 information storage medium의 owner/manager인 suspect를 substantial person subject to seizure로 보아 participation right를 인정하였다. Such doctrine must likewise apply to the latter situation, where a third party possessed or kept the information storage medium on the basis of a possessory-mediated relationship formed according to the owner/manager’s intention and coercive disposition is made against the third party. When determining whether the subject falls within the object of the participation-right guarantee, there is no reason to treat differently the case where the separation of the owner/manager and actual possessor/custodian of the information storage medium occurred according to the owner/manager’s intention and the case where it did not. In both cases, they are the same in that the manager/disposer of the electronic information is the subject to whom personality-related legal interests, which may be infringed by the law enforcement agency’s arbitrary copying of irrelevant information etc., belong.
3) criteria for determining the substantial person subject to seizure
가) Whether one corresponds to the substantial person subject to seizure as the subject to whom the participation right belongs must be determined on the basis of the factual state outwardly and objectively recognizable at the time of seizure and search, such as who actually dominated and managed the relevant information storage medium until the time of seizure and search or a temporally close point thereto, and whether, based on the objective circumstances surrounding the progress of the investigation and the loss of possession or possessory mediation concerning the information storage medium, the law enforcement agency could recognize that an owner/manager existed separately from the possessor/custodian of the information storage medium. Internal, subjective circumstances between related persons that the law enforcement agency could not recognize at the time of seizure and search, or a legal and retrospective judgment concerning the attribution of rights under civil law, are not to be considered. In addition, even a person who actually dominated and managed the information storage medium is excluded from the subject to whom the participation right belongs if he/she transferred it to a third party according to his/her own intention or abandoned the right of domination and control over it(see the above Supreme Court decision 2021DO11170).
나) When, as above, the substantial person subject to seizure is determined based on the objectively and outwardly recognizable factual state at the time of seizure and search, there is little risk of causing confusion and side effects in investigative practice, such as being unable to identify the person with the participation right or unreasonably expanding the scope of the guarantee of participation rights to many persons. This is because, unless there are special circumstances suggesting the existence of a separate manager/disposer, it is acceptable to regard the actual possessor/custodian of the information storage medium at the time of seizure and search as the manager/disposer of the electronic information, and it is sufficient to regard a person as the substantial person subject to seizure only when there are special circumstances from which the law enforcement agency can, based on the objectively and outwardly recognizable factual state, acknowledge that a person who exclusively holds authority to manage and dispose of the electronic information exists separately from the actual possessor/custodian of the information storage medium. For example, this includes cases where, from an objective and outward perspective, a customer’s information storage medium kept in a bank safe or a client’s computer temporarily kept by a computer repair company that has been entrusted with repair is plainly separated, by its very nature, from the actual possessor/custodian and the exclusive manager/disposer of the electronic information, or where the law enforcement agency can recognize, through the statement of the actual possessor/custodian of the information storage medium or the progress of the investigation, that a separate exclusive manager/disposer of the electronic information exists.
다) majority opinion은 이 사건 hard disk의 concealment and voluntary submission course 등에 비추어 seizure and search at the time or at a time close thereto에 이 사건 hard disk를 actually possessed한 person은 공소외 3이고 그렇다면 다른 special circumstance가 없는 한 이 사건 hard disk에 stored된 electronic information에 관한 management and disposition authority를 de facto possess and exercise할 수 있는 status에 있는 person도 공소외 3이라고 하였으나, 이는 proper하지 않다. 이 case에서 principal offenders인 공소외 1 등과 evidence concealer인 공소외 3에 대한 각 investigation procedures의 progress, 이 사건 hard disk를 voluntary submission하면서 공소외 3이 law enforcement agency에 한 statements의 content 등 law enforcement agency가 objectively and outwardly recognizable한 factual state에 비추어 볼 때, law enforcement agency는 이를 voluntary submission받을 당시 이 사건 hard disk의 actual possessor/custodian인 공소외 3 외에 electronic information의 exclusive managers/disposers인 공소외 1 등이 existed함을 recognize할 수 있었기 때문이다. 특히 law enforcement agency가 principal offender에 대한 suspicion facts를 investigate하던 중 principal offender-owned/controlled information storage medium를 conceal하고 있던 person을 evidence concealment crime suspect로 삼아 concealment item을 voluntary submission받았다는 것은 그 자체로 voluntary submission 당시 law enforcement agency가 evidence concealment offender의 constitutive element인 principal offender의 existence와 해당 concealed item가 principal offender-owned/controlled한 것임을 recognized하고 있었음을 의미한다는 점에서도 그러하다.
라. scope of the guarantee of participation rights in the case of the principal offender and the evidence concealer
1) participation right guarantee doctrine은 principal offender가 suspicion facts에 대한 evidence를 conceal하고자 자신이 owned and controlled하던 information storage medium를 evidence concealer에게 전달하면서 evidence concealment를 instigate하고, evidence concealer가 이를 possess and keep하며 conceal하고 있던 중 seizure 또는 voluntary submission form으로 law enforcement agency에 submit하는 경우에도 same하게 적용되어야 한다. 이 case에서 principal offender는 concealed item의 actual possessor/custodian인 evidence concealer에 대한 relation에서 typical possessory-mediated relationship에 놓이는 information storage medium의 owner/manager로서 seizure and search process에서 irrelevant information의 search and collection 등을 막아 privacy secrecy and freedom 등의 rights를 protect할 interest가 있는 substantial person subject to seizure에 해당한다. evidence concealer가 evidence concealment suspicion의 suspect status에서 이를 law enforcement agency에 voluntary submission하였다고 하더라도 substantial person subject to seizure는 principal offender이므로 그에게도 participation rights가 guaranteed되어야 한다. hidden item인 information storage medium 내의 irrelevant information에 관한 personality-related legal interests attribution subject가 아닌 evidence concealer는 participation right를 guarantee받더라도 이를 substantially exercise할 아무런 incentive가 없으므로, principal offender를 exclude하고 그에만 participation right를 guarantee하는 것으로는 warrant requirement enforcement를 위하여 participation right를 guarantee한 purport를 implement할 수 없다. hidden item인 information storage medium의 seizure and search procedure에서 law enforcement agency에 의해 principal offender의 private life에 관한 irrelevant information이 extensively and indiscriminately collected될 possibility를 차단하기도 어렵다. 이 case에서도 evidence concealer인 공소외 3은 participation right exercise를 waive하였다.
2) principal offender가 자신의 suspicion facts에 관한 evidence인 electronic information가 stored된 information storage medium를 evidence concealer에게 deliver하여 concealment act를 instigate한 경우, 그 electronic information에 관한 management and disposition authority를 definitely and completely abandon하였다고 인정할 만한 other special circumstance가 없는 한, 그와 같은 delivery로 information storage medium에 대한 actual and direct possession이 evidence concealer에게 transferred되었다는 circumstance만으로 principal offender가 electronic information에 관한 management and disposition authority를 transfer or abandon하였다거나 그로써 information storage medium에 intermingled된 irrelevant information에 관한 law enforcement agency의 search 등을 exclude하고 privacy secrecy and freedom 등의 personality-related legal interests protection을 받을 수 있는 participation right에 관한 interest가 extinguished되었다고 conclude할 수 없다.
Considering characteristics of information storage media and electronic information, the purpose of their concealment, the circumstances of the evidence concealment, whether the concealed evidence is to be returned, and the true intentions of the parties, it is natural and consistent with experience rules to interpret that the principal offender merely entrusted the storage to the evidence concealer on a temporary basis through concealment of the information storage medium until the risk of exposure or discovery of relevant information disappeared, and that, once that risk disappeared, the principal offender intended to regain actual dominion over the information storage medium, including the electronic information that is irrelevant evidence. Owing to the characteristics of the possessory-mediated relationship formed between the principal offender and the evidence concealer concerning the concealment of an information storage medium in which relevant information and irrelevant information are intermingled, the principal offender should be understood as having concealed the information storage medium with the intention not only of evading his/her criminal responsibility but also of preserving and keeping the irrelevant information, which has personal and personality-related value, and of receiving it back at an appropriate time in the future, in a situation where it is technically difficult to sift out and discard or destroy only the relevant information inside the information storage medium.
3) majority opinion은 principal offender인 공소외 1이 principal-offense suspicion facts에 관한 evidence인 이 사건 hard disk의 existence itself를 conceal할 purpose로 ‘자신에 대한 investigation이 끝날 때까지’ hide할 것을 부탁하며 공소외 3에게 deliver함으로써 자신과 이 사건 hard disk 등 사이의 outward connection을 conceal and sever하겠다는 purpose 아래 ‘investigation completion’이라는 indefinite term까지 그에 대한 exclusive domination and control right를 abandon하거나 공소외 3에게 wholly transfer한다는 intention을 express하였다고 보았다.
However, majority opinion은 typical possessory-mediated relationship인 ‘principal offender and evidence concealer’ structure에서의 reasonable interpretation 범위를 벗어난 것으로 proper하지 않다.
또한 majority opinion은 participation right guarantee와 관련하여 information storage medium가 갖는 irrelevant evidence intermingling이라는 special feature and importance를 overlook하여 이를 murder offense tool인 weapon이나 drug-related offense에 provided된 narcotics, syringes 등과 같이 그 자체로 crime suspicion facts에 관한 evidence인 tangible objects concealment를 instigate하는 경우와 동일하게 evaluate하는 error가 있다. 애당초 relevant evidence와 irrelevant evidence가 intermingled된 information storage medium가 seizure and search etc. coercive disposition에서 갖는 personality-related legal interests meaning context가 위의 weapon이나 narcotics와 같은 evidence object의 case와 동일하였다면 precedents가 electronic information seizure and search procedure에서 person subject to seizure에게 participation right를 guarantee하는 legal doctrine을 establish할 need도 없었을 것이다.
majority opinion은 이 사건의 principal offender와 evidence concealer 사이의 hidden item인 electronic information의 domination and management를 둘러싼 intention interpretation issue나 participation right attribution subject confirmation issue를, 공소외 1이 evidence concealment instigation through judicial function concerning principal offense investigation를 infringe한 act에 대한 illegality evaluation나 blameability 또는 criminal responsibility recognition 여부와 confuse하고 있는 것이기도 하다. If there were no act of instigation of evidence concealment by the principal offender, that is, if the principal offender had concealed the information storage medium by handing it over to a third party unaware of the concealment intent while concealing such intent, would the majority opinion really take the same view and exclude the principal offender’s participation right? If the conclusion regarding the existence or nonexistence of the principal offender’s participation right differs in the two cases, this can only be seen as confusing the assessment of the punishability of the instigation of concealment and the issue of identifying the subject to whom participation rights belong.
4) 이 case에서 majority opinion이, principal offender에 대한 suspicion facts를 investigate하던 중 evidence concealer로부터 그가 hidden하고 있던 principal offender-owned/controlled information storage medium를 voluntary submission받은 경우, evidence concealer에 대한 investigation procedure는 substantially principal offender에 대한 investigation procedure의 part로 performed되는 attribute를 overlook하고, ‘principal offender and evidence concealer’ structure의 possessory-mediated relationship에서 participation right attribution subject인 substantial person subject to seizure is who라는 legal issue에 대한 exploration을 avoid한 채 principal offender가 evidence concealer에게 management and disposition authority를 transferred or abandoned하였느냐라는 intention interpretation issue로 처리한 것은 human rights protection의 bastion인 Supreme Court가 취할 proper attitude가 아니다.
마. this case에 관한 judgment
1) 이 사건 hard disk의 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure and search at the time or at a time close thereto에서 outwardly and objectively recognizable한 factual state를 기준으로 한 다음 circumstances에 비추어 볼 때, 공소외 3의 voluntary submission 당시 및 이와 time-wise close한 시기까지 principal offender인 공소외 1 등이 actual possession 또는 공소외 3을 통한 possessory-mediated relationship를 바탕으로 이 사건 hard disk를 dominate and manage하면서 그에 stored된 electronic information에 관하여 법익 귀속 주체로서 exclusive management and disposition authority를 possess and exercise하고 있었고, 그에 대한 management and disposition authority나 possession/control를 lost한 바 없다. Accordingly, 공소외 1 등이 그 electronic information에 관한 substantial person subject to seizure라고 봄이 proper하다.
가) 이 사건 hard disk는 공소외 1 등의 residence 내 study 등에 놓여 있던 individual computers에 installed되어 있었다. 공소외 1 등에 대한 principal-offense suspect facts의 investigation 중 발생한 공소외 3과 공소외 1의 evidence concealment offense course, 이 사건 hard disk에 stored되어 있던 electronic information의 content 등을 살펴보더라도, 공소외 1 등은 공소외 3의 voluntary submission date로부터 merely 11 days 전인 2019. 8. 31.까지도 이 사건 hard disk를 exclusively using하고 있었다고 볼 수 있다.
나) 이 사건 hard disk는 공소외 1 등이 residence에서 long-term personally used해 온 computer의 information storage medium으로서 공소외 1 등에 대한 principal-offense suspect facts와 related된 evidence 외에도 공소외 1과 그 family members의 various personal information가 stored되어 있는 것이다. 이 사건 hard disk가 personal information으로서 갖는 subjective value에 비추어 볼 때 공소외 1이 공소외 3에게 이 사건 hard disk를 handed over한 것은 future prosecution investigations에 대비하여 이를 hide하라고 한 것이지 이를 eliminate하려는 것은 아니었다고 보인다. 공소외 3은 law enforcement agency에 이 사건 hard disk를 voluntary submission하기 직전까지도 공소외 1의 concealment instruction에 따라 이를 gym personal locker 등에 keep and manage하고 있었고, 이 사건 hard disk와 함께 concealed하고 있던 별도의 (명칭 4 생략) University professor office personal computer를 공소외 1의 request에 따라 return하기도 하였다. In this special form of possessory-mediated relationship formed by receiving the 이 사건 hard disk, 공소외 3은 언제든 공소외 1의 instruction가 있을 경우 이를 공소외 1에게 return하는 등 instruction purport에 따른 disposition에 나아갈 intention으로 이 사건 hard disk를 keep하여 concealment act를 execute하였는바, 이 사건 hard disk의 voluntary submission at the time 공소외 1 등이 이 사건 hard disk에 대한 management and disposition authority나 possession/control를 completely lost하였다고 보기 어렵다.
다) 그 무렵의 investigation progress, 공소외 3의 voluntary submission at the time prosecutor statements 등에 비추어, law enforcement agency도 이 사건 hard disk를 voluntary submission으로 seize할 당시 그 owner/management status와 exclusive user가 who인지에 대하여 knew or sufficiently could know하였다고 볼 수 있다.
2) law enforcement agency는 공소외 1에 대한 principal-offense suspect facts의 investigation 중 이 사건 hard disk를 공소외 3으로부터 voluntary submission받아 seize한 뒤 그에 stored된 electronic information를 search, extract하는 등의 series of processes에서 person subject to seizure인 공소외 3 외에 이 사건 hard disk 및 electronic information의 substantial person subject to seizure인 공소외 1 등에게 participation opportunity를 guarantee하여야 한다. However, in such a series of processes, law enforcement agency는 person subject to seizure인 공소외 3 외에 substantial person subject to seizure인 공소외 1 등에게 participation right를 guarantee하지 않았다.
Accordingly, law enforcement agency가 seized한 이 사건 hard disk 내 electronic information은 illegally obtained evidence에 해당하고 이를 guilty evidence로 사용할 수 없다. 달리 그 exception을 인정할 special circumstance도 발견하기 어렵다. law enforcement agency가 그 illegally obtained evidence에 base하여 collected한 related persons의 statements etc.도 illegally obtained evidence에 based한 derivative evidence에 해당하여 역시 guilty recognition evidence로 삼을 수 없다.
3) 이 사건에서 evidentiary capacity가 없는 evidence를 제외한 remaining evidence들만으로는 이 사건 공소사실이 reasonable doubt를 exclude할 정도로 proven되었다고 보기 어렵다고 볼 여지가 있다. Nevertheless, lower court는 그 판시와 같은 reason으로 이 사건 공소사실을 guilty로 인정한 first-instance judgment를 그대로 maintained하였다. Such lower court determination에는 voluntarily submitted items seizure에서 participation right, illegally obtained evidence exclusion rule에 관한 legal principles를 misunderstood하고 필요한 심리를 다하지 않아 judgment에 영향을 미친 error가 있다.
이상과 같은 reason으로 majority opinion에 찬성할 수 없음을 밝힌다.
5. supplementary opinion of Supreme Court Justices Ahn Cheol-sang, Noh Tae-ak, and Cheon Dae-yeop on the majority opinion
전자정보의 seizure and search process에서 procedural legality를 확보하기 위한 participation right의 subject와 관련하여, formal person subject to seizure가 아닌 suspect가 ‘substantial person subject to seizure’에 해당하는 경우 suspect에게 participation right를 guarantee한 a series of precedents의 holdings and purport에 비추어 보면, 공소외 3이 이 사건 hard disk를 voluntary submission함에 따른 seizure and search scope는 그 motivation이 된 crime suspicion facts인 ‘evidence concealment crime’와 related된 evidence에 한정되므로, 해당 crime suspicion facts의 suspect이자 해당 evidence object인 information storage medium에 대한 actual domination and manager인 공소외 3에게 participation right를 guarantee함으로써 procedural legality가 recognized됨은 clear하다고 할 것이어서, 이에 관한 additional argumentation이 needed하다고 보이지 않는다. Below, we supplement the grounds of majority opinion only to the extent necessary to prevent misunderstanding of majority opinion’s purport among the matters pointed out in the dissenting opinion.
가. the purport of precedents concerning participation rights
precedents의 ‘substantial person subject to seizure’ concept는 tangible objects를 premise로 한 traditional seizure and search doctrine이 anticipated하지 못한 electronic information seizure and search에 관한 participation right guarantee phase에서 statutory wording과 constitutional due process principle·warrant requirement를 center로 한 basic ideology and reality gap을 overcome하기 위해 devised된 a kind of instrumental concept이다. participation right에 관한 a series of precedents에 담긴 purport는, embedded multiple and diverse individual information의 attribution subject를 알기 어려운 information storage medium에 대한 seizure and search에서 principle로 electronic information 전반의 management and disposition authority자인 person subject to seizure를 center로 regulate하되, 다만 person subject to seizure가 crime suspicion facts and seized items와 아무런 substantial interest가 없는 경우에는 seizure and search procedure에 participate할 이유가 없는 반면, substantial interest가 있는 suspect는 person subject to seizure가 아니라는 reason으로 participation right가 excluded됨으로써 누구의 participation도 없이 indiscriminate seizure and search execution이 이루어질 수 있는 possibility를 prevent하기 위하여, ‘substantial person subject to seizure’ concept를 통해 이 문제를 resolve하려는 데 있다.
이러한 precedents의 stance에 비추어, evidence concealer가 concealment act의 object인 information storage medium를 evidence concealment crime suspicion facts에 관하여 voluntary submission하는 경우에는, 비록 해당 information storage medium가 principal offender의 property더라도 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure and search의 motivation이자 cause가 된 crime suspicion facts의 suspect임과 동시에 voluntary submitter로서 person subject to seizure에 해당하는 evidence concealer에게 participation right를 부여하는 것으로 sufficient하고, 이에 더 나아가 principal offender를 substantial person subject to seizure로 보아 그에게까지 participation right를 인정할 need는 없다. In this case, because the suspect, who is the evidence concealer, voluntary submission a information storage medium in his/her possession or custody that is recognized as related to the investigation into his/her own criminal facts, the evidence concealer has direct, substantial, and legal interests as both suspect and person subject to seizure in the seizure and search flowing therefrom. The 2016DO348 en banc decision, in recognizing participation rights for a suspect who is not the formal person subject to seizure as the ‘substantial person subject to seizure,’ addressed a different plane of discussion from the evidence concealer’s voluntary submission case, because in that case the person subject to seizure, who was the formal voluntary submitter, was merely a victim of the criminal facts and the purpose of guaranteeing the opportunity to participate to that person alone could not substantially realize the purpose of the participation-right guarantee.
In short, where the suspect in the criminal facts that caused the seizure and search not only is related to the facts suspected but also has direct, substantial, and legal interests by dominating and managing the information storage medium and electronic evidence that are the objects of the seizure and search, if participation rights are guaranteed to that suspect, who simultaneously occupies the status of interested person and person subject to seizure, the procedural legality concerning the participation right can be viewed as thereby satisfied and completed. Unless there are other special circumstances, there is no need to separately posit the substantial person subject to seizure in such a case.
Turning to this case, the instant hard disk was voluntary submitted to the law enforcement agency by 공소외 3, the evidence concealer, while he was dominating and managing it after receiving it from 공소외 1, and, in relation to the concealment of evidence that constituted his own criminal facts, 공소외 3 has direct, substantial, and legal interests in the instant hard disk, which is the evidence. Accordingly, insofar as the seizure and search procedure for the instant hard disk was conducted with the participation of 공소외 3, who is the rightful interested party, the procedural legality of that procedure is, in principle, satisfied by affording 공소외 3 the opportunity to participate. Further, the dissenting opinion, which would allow an anti-constitutional result infringing the legal interests concerning secrecy and freedom of private life, etc. by not even granting participation rights to 공소외 1 etc., who handed over the instant hard disk for the purpose of destroying evidence, is difficult to accept.
나. recognition of participation rights based on the criminal facts that caused the seizure and search
Recognition of the participation right, including the concept of the ‘substantial person subject to seizure,’ should in principle be based on the criminal facts that caused the seizure and search. The scope and limits of guaranteeing participation rights should be determined through a balancing of the purpose sought to be achieved through the procedure and the interests infringed thereby, taking into account the characteristics of the investigative procedure. This is because the purport of the participation right is to minimize infringement of the legal interests of the person subject to seizure in the course of a real property-based coercive disposition, while at the same time the ideal of criminal justice—discovering the substantive truth through prompt and effective investigation—must also be harmoniously realized to the extent that such legal interests are not essentially infringed.
The dissenting opinion’s purport is that participation rights in the electronic information seizure and search procedure should be understood separately from the criminal facts that caused the seizure and search. However, criminal facts are both the ultimate object and purpose to be elucidated through coercive investigation and the basis and cause of the issuance of a warrant and the seizure and search, and the electronic information that is searched, copied, and printed in the process of executing the warrant is also the direct object related to the relevant facts. Therefore, the criminal facts concerned are the most important consideration in the process of searching, copying, and printing relevant electronic information, and it is neither natural nor in accord with the purport of participation rights to disregard precisely the most important element in the relevant criminal procedure when recognizing that procedural right. The precedents concerning this have attempted to rationally interpret, in light of actual and concrete circumstances, the provisions on seizure and search centered on tangible objects, which do not adequately reflect the characteristics of electronic information and its storage medium; however, the dissenting opinion overemphasizes certain phrases from the precedents or understands them superficially, and in the end develops an argument that does not fit the wording of Criminal Procedure Act and is also detached from the ideal of criminal justice, so it is difficult to accept. This is because the question of whether seizure and search of electronic information related to criminal facts and the guarantee of participation rights are centered on the information storage medium and its manager/controller, versus the question of whether they are understood separately from the criminal facts, are entirely different matters.
Furthermore, understanding participation rights on the premise of the criminal facts is also consistent with warrant-execution practice, where promptness, expedition, timeliness, and secrecy are important, because it enables concise and clear identification of the subject of the participation right. The above Supreme Court decision 2021DO11170, premised on the 2016DO348 en banc decision that where a third party voluntary submitted a suspect’s information storage medium in relation to the suspect’s criminal facts, participation rights should be guaranteed to the suspect, who is the substantial person subject to seizure, held that whether the information storage medium falls within the category for which participation rights are recognized for the suspect should be determined based on the objectively and outwardly recognizable factual state. This is also to harmoniously realize the ideals of criminal justice—protection of basic rights and discovery of substantive truth—by reasonably setting the scope of participation rights in light of the on-site nature of seizure and search, etc. The dissenting opinion’s approach, which determines participation rights solely on the basis of the possibility of infringement of legal interests concerning irrelevant information in the process of searching, copying, and printing electronic information, ignores the essence of participation rights derived from coercive investigation procedures concerning the facts charged and presupposes that the law enforcement agency’s seizure and search is, as a rule or in general, exploratory and searching and thus unlawful. Although the concern it raises is understandable, this is a matter to be resolved through the rational interpretation of the relevant legal doctrines, including the participation right, as well as through the application of strict rules of evidence; it is not possible, on that basis, to construct a general doctrine premised on such an exceptional situation.
다. transfer of the authority to manage and dispose and the existence of the participation right
Where a third party voluntary submits a information storage medium belonging to or under the control of the suspect, in order for the suspect to be evaluated as the substantial party to the seizure and search of all electronic information stored in that information storage medium and to receive participation rights, the suspect must, until the time of seizure and search or a temporally close point thereto, have actually dominated and managed the relevant information storage medium while retaining and exercising the “exclusive” authority to manage and dispose of all electronic information in that information storage medium, and must not otherwise have transferred or abandoned it to a third party according to his/her will. Meanwhile, as precedent has clearly stated, “authority to manage and dispose” here is for the purpose of setting a reasonable scope of protection for participation rights by harmonizing protection of basic rights and the ideal of discovery of substantive truth in the seizure and search procedure of electronic information, and is not for the purpose of determining private-law rights and relationships from a legal and retrospective perspective according to the attribution of rights under civil law(the above Supreme Court decision 2021DO11170).
In light of such legal principles, the reason 공소외 1 etc. are not regarded as the substantial persons subject to seizure and thus participation rights are not recognized in the process of voluntary submission and seizure of the instant hard disk and the stored electronic information is self-evident. Since 공소외 1 handed the instant hard disk to 공소외 3 and instructed concealment of evidence, and 공소외 3 concealed it, it is clear that 공소외 1 etc. thereby lost actual domination and management of the instant hard disk; furthermore, the authority to manage and dispose of all stored electronic information was transferred to 공소외 3, and in fact 공소외 3, by concealing the instant hard disk in a place known only to him, even placed the entire information storage medium and built-in electronic information in a situation where he could, according to his own judgment, manage and dispose of them at will so that they would not be exposed to the law enforcement agency. Accordingly, at least for 공소외 1 etc., it must be regarded that they had already reached a state where they could no longer retain and exercise the “exclusive” authority to manage and dispose.
Moreover, the fact that the principal offender not only conceals the evidence himself/herself but also instructs the evidence concealer, who is the principal offender in form, and thereby causes the state of evidence concealment, exceeds the scope of legitimate defense rights. Even in light of the fact that the principal offender intentionally created a state in which evidence had departed from its position while infringing the judicial function of the State, it is normatively consistent to regard that the participation right, which is a procedural right in criminal proceedings, or the authority to manage and dispose underlying it, is no longer reserved to the principal offender as a result of such infringement of the State’s judicial function. This also accords with the ideal of criminal justice, which seeks to harmonize discovery of the substantive truth and the principle of due process and thereby realize justice. As noted above, with respect to the criminal facts that caused the voluntary submission in this case or the instant hard disk, which is the evidence in question, 공소외 3 corresponds to a person having direct, substantial, and legal interests; therefore, by guaranteeing 공소외 3 the opportunity to participate in the seizure and search process concerning the instant hard disk, the procedural legality thereof can, in principle, be recognized, and this is all the more so because there are no special circumstances that would otherwise require viewing that multiple separate participation-right holders exist.
This is not an evaluation of the illegality of 공소외 1’s act of instigating concealment of evidence, but rather an evaluation grounded in the purport of precedent following the loss of 공소외 1 etc.’s “exclusive” authority to manage and dispose of the instant hard disk, so the dissenting opinion’s criticism on this point is incorrect. The dissenting opinion’s argument that a different conclusion can be reached on the basis of civil-law doctrines such as possessory-mediated relationships is likewise difficult to accept for the same reason, even without resort to the same civil-law doctrines of anti-social conduct or performance for unlawful cause, etc.
d. other circumstances
The other grounds advanced by the dissenting opinion likewise cannot be adopted as general legal doctrine or as the conclusion of this case and the subsumption doctrine of precedent.
One point to add in this regard is that the majority opinion does not differ from the dissenting opinion even as to the direction of guaranteeing participation rights in seizure and search procedures proposed by the dissenting opinion. Compared with the legislative examples or trial practice of major foreign jurisdictions, our doctrine concerning participation rights in seizure and search procedures is still in the process of formation. Its orientation lies in realizing, in the seizure and search of electronic information, the constitutional principles of warrant requirement and due process while preventing infringement of fundamental rights such as privacy secrecy and freedom and the right to information self-determination, but the essence of coercive investigation procedures is, in any event, to function so as to secure procedural legality and legitimacy in the seizure and search process concerning specific criminal facts suspected. In addition, since it must not be substantially detached from the ideal of criminal justice—discovering the substantive truth through prompt and effective investigation—it is necessary to approach carefully so as not to lose direction, but while striking a balance among conflicting values, also not to deviate from concrete propriety and common-sense conclusions. In that respect, I would like to make clear that, at least in this case, it is only that the dissenting opinion cannot be adopted; the majority opinion does not negate all of the arguments or purport developed by the dissenting opinion.
6. concurring opinion of Supreme Court Justice Oh Kyung-mi on the dissenting opinion
recently your smartphone that you lost by leaving it in a taxi is illegally distributed and used in a voice phishing crime and then seized by the law enforcement agency can happen at any time. The same is true of the situation where your child, who had briefly borrowed and used your smartphone, is caught engaging in illegal filming on the subway and voluntary submits it to the law enforcement agency. If the law enforcement agency learns that you are the owner/manager of the smartphone and that your personal information is stored in it, is the procedural legality concerning participation rights satisfied and completed by recognizing participation rights only for the voice-phishing offender or your child, who are the persons subject to seizure and suspects with “direct, substantial, and legal interests” based on the criminal facts in the course of the search and extraction process? The concurring opinion of Supreme Court Justices Ahn Cheol-sang, Noh Tae-ak, and Cheon Dae-yeop on the majority opinion(이하 ‘majority concurring opinion’이라 한다)은 yes라고 answers. In such a situation, can one accept that the law enforcement agency searches and extracts your personal information from your smartphone without your knowledge? Was the participation right in the seizure and search of electronic information recognized by precedent such a flimsy and formal right? The dissenting opinion says no. That is precisely the issue in this case.
가. concerning the assertion that participation rights must be recognized based on the criminal facts
1) majority concurring opinion’s assertion that the subject of participation rights must be recognized centering on the criminal facts amounts, in the end, to recognizing participation rights based on “suspect status.” Such an assertion not only contravenes the explicit stance and flow of the precedents concerning the purport of guaranteeing participation rights, but also contradicts majority concurring opinion’s own reasoning.
The precedents have repeatedly and explicitly stated that the practical significance and purport of participation rights lie in protecting the person subject to seizure, who is placed at risk of indiscriminate searching and collecting of information unrelated to the suspect facts that caused the seizure and search, in the opportunity for lawful coercive disposition concerning relevant information. The need to be protected from such risks is unrelated to whether the person subject to seizure is a suspect. Rather, from the standpoint of balancing interests, a person subject to seizure who is not a suspect would likely find it even more difficult to accept having to endure disclosure of private life for the investigation of another person(the suspect) unrelated to himself/herself. The above Supreme Court decision 2019DO7342 clearly stated that, even where a suspect who had secretly installed a disguised camera etc. in a lodging establishment solely for the purpose of illegal filming corresponds to the substantial person subject to seizure as the manager/disposer of the electronic information, there is no need to recognize participation rights, thereby making clear that if there is no risk of infringement of the person subject to seizure’s legal interests concerning irrelevant information, there is no practical benefit in guaranteeing participation rights. By contrast, majority concurring opinion’s argument that participation rights should be attributed centering on the criminal facts or suspect status can, in effect, be seen as conflicting with the above precedents’ legal doctrine.
Moreover, majority concurring opinion also stated that the purport of the precedents concerning participation rights is to regulate, in principle, seizure and search of a information storage medium centering on the person subject to seizure, who is the manager/disposer of all electronic information, but to use the concept of the substantial person subject to seizure instrumentally in order to solve the problem of no participation-right holder where the person subject to seizure has no substantive interest in the criminal facts and the seized items. Even so, majority concurring opinion’s argument that the subject of participation rights should be recognized centering on the criminal facts lacks consistency.
2) majority concurring opinion uses “direct, substantial, and legal interest” in the criminal facts or seized items as an important indicator for recognizing participation rights, but such an interest is unrelated to the purport of the precedents in which participation rights were recognized or to their protected sphere, so it is not logical to use it as an indicator for the attribution of participation rights.
Although the exact purport of “direct, substantial, and legal interest in the criminal facts or seized items” as used by majority concurring opinion is not clear, it appears roughly to mean “the interest of a suspect, from the suspect’s standpoint, in avoiding exposure of evidence concerning his/her own criminal facts to the law enforcement agency in order to evade criminal liability,” that is, the “suspect’s defense-right-related interest concerning relevant evidence.” If so, this is not directly related to the purport of participation-right guarantees explicitly declared by the precedents. What exists to protect such an interest is the traditionally recognized principle of due process and the principle of warrant requirement itself. It is precisely that, unless there is a warrant lawfully issued by a judge through the specification and substantiation of the suspect’s criminal suspicion, the “suspect’s defense-right-related interest concerning relevant evidence” is not infringed. Once a warrant has been lawfully issued, both the suspect and any third party must endure the coercive disposition of relevant evidence, which is evidence within the line drawn by the warrant, i.e. within the “principle of relevance.” This is the active aspect of the warrant requirement vis-à-vis the law enforcement agency. In this area, participation rights do not have special significance.
Participation rights function in the passive aspect of the warrant requirement vis-à-vis the law enforcement agency. That is, they are the power to restrain and deny effect when the law enforcement agency’s coercive disposition extends to irrelevant evidence, i.e. evidence outside the line drawn by the warrant, the “principle of relevance.” Participation rights protect, in this area, the interests of the subject of the coercive disposition in respect of irrelevant evidence outside the above line.
In the end, the “direct, substantial, and legal interest” referred to by majority concurring opinion is not much different from the “relevance” that determines the scope of the warrant’s effect, and, at least as to recognition of participation rights, it has no meaning beyond being the benchmark for distinguishing relevant evidence from irrelevant evidence. The sphere protected by participation rights according to precedent is the sphere of irrelevant evidence, and it does not overlap at all with the sphere in which a “direct, substantial, and legal interest in the criminal facts or seized items” is recognized.
나. concerning the criticism of “detachment from the criminal facts”
majority concurring opinion points out that the dissenting opinion understood participation rights separately from the criminal facts that caused the seizure and search, but this is a misunderstanding of the dissenting opinion and is an assertion that cannot logically stand. Participation rights form one pillar of the warrant requirement and, by their nature, cannot be discussed detached from the criminal facts.
Even under the dissenting opinion, the criminal facts substantially affect the setting of the scope or limits of participation rights. In order to set the scope of the guarantee of participation rights, a distinction between relevant information and irrelevant information must first be made, and this is based on the criminal facts. In other words, the line of the “principle of relevance,” which functions in the passive aspect of the warrant requirement vis-à-vis the law enforcement agency, is set based on the criminal facts. The area outside that line is the area of participation rights. In the end, the concept of the substantial person subject to seizure according to the dissenting opinion is by no means understood detached from the criminal facts that caused the seizure and search; rather, it is a concept associated with irrelevant evidence premised on the criminal facts.
다. implications for investigative practice for protecting fundamental rights suited to a highly advanced information society
A smartphone spends all day with its owner/manager in daily life and stores his/her personal information in detail. Corporations cannot conduct business activities without large-capacity computers, servers, and the exchange and storage of information through the internet. Furthermore, due to the increase in portability and mobility, it often happens that information storage media leave the possession of the owner/manager, either according to his/her will or regardless of it, and come to be in the possession or custody of another person. In the seizure and search process of the law enforcement agency, one frequently encounters situations in which a suspect conceals or discards his/her mobile phone or computer etc. The dissenting opinion assumes a relation of dispossession or a possessory-mediated relationship etc., as the situation in which participation-right issues arise. It is not unusual for the owner/manager of a information storage medium and the law enforcement agency to stand in opposition within such a relationship.
With the dramatic development of information technology, the problematic situations surrounding information storage media will become even more complex in the future, and the proposition that the coercive disposition of the law enforcement agency concerning such matters must be constitutionally controlled so that investigative practice develops in a direction that guarantees fundamental rights has become self-evident. The Supreme Court should present, as a guarantee of the procedural right demanded by such a proposition, the standards for seizure and search procedures of electronic information that can both respond to the constitutional demand by guaranteeing procedural rights and satisfy the ideals of criminal justice through discovery of the substantive truth. The dissenting opinion, reflecting the factors considered by precedent in developing the participation-right doctrine, typifies situations of seizure and search of electronic information and establishes a unified standard capable of protecting the interests of the substantial person subject to seizure based on the principle of warrant requirement. This can serve as a guideline for investigative practice to develop in response to the advancement of the information society while efficiently fulfilling the role of discovering the substantive truth and also meeting the demand for protection of fundamental rights.
라. the relationship between expansion of participation-right guarantees and the ideal of discovering substantive truth
The criticism that, if the dissenting opinion is followed, confusion and burden will be imposed on investigative practice and another ideal of criminal justice, discovery of the substantive truth, may regress, is not correct. The scope of the guarantee of participation rights has already expanded to the substantial person subject to seizure by virtue of the legal doctrine of the 2016DO348 en banc decision. This doctrine is evaluated as having achieved a balance and harmony between the ideal of criminal justice that, in the seizure and search procedure of electronic information, the warrant requirement must be effectuated so as to guarantee the fundamental rights of the person subject to seizure concerning irrelevant information, and the other ideal of discovering substantive truth. It is true that law enforcement agencies have come to bear a greater burden than before in determining the scope of participation-right guarantees, but such a circumstance cannot be described as a regression of the criminal justice ideal of discovering substantive truth. Criticizing the dissenting opinion, which sets the scope of the participation-right guarantee on the basis of the above legal doctrine, as causing a retreat in the discovery of substantive truth is no different from criticizing the 2016DO348 en banc decision on the same grounds.
The seizure and search practice of electronic information is being carried out in the form of imaging the information storage medium on site, taking it out, and then searching and printing relevant information externally in a separate procedure. Since finding and seizing the tangible object of a information storage medium at the scene is not greatly different from coercive investigation of traditional tangible objects, there is no additional restraint imposed on warrant-execution practice by expanding participation rights. The part where additional burden arises is in the imaging procedure and the procedure in which relevant information is separately searched and printed externally. However, because this part of the procedure is separately performed after the law enforcement agency has securely secured the information storage medium and the electronic information therein based on on-site presence and secrecy etc., it is difficult to say that the expansion of participation rights creates additional obstacles to the on-site nature, speed, timeliness, and secrecy of the investigative procedure or burdens it to the degree that it would regress the criminal justice ideal of discovering substantive truth. Rather, majority concurring opinion, by invoking the efficiency of investigative procedure and discovery of substantive truth, is causing the principle of warrant requirement and due process, which are demanded for the protection of the fundamental rights of individuals and businesses in a highly developed information society, to regress.
마. participation-right issues arising from concealment of information storage media etc.
When the law enforcement agency investigating the principal offender’s facts suspected of crime traces the whereabouts of the principal offender’s concealed information storage medium and ultimately secures it from a third party who concealed evidence, is the principal offender not guaranteed participation rights in the search and printing process? Is it not a distortion of the fundamental purpose of the participation-right doctrine established by precedent to apply it so formally that it is sufficient to guarantee participation rights only to the third party, the evidence concealer? In such a situation, is there any device that ensures constitutional control over the execution of the warrant other than guaranteeing the principal offender’s participation rights? Is there any difference, for purposes of guaranteeing participation rights, between seizing a information storage medium directly from the suspect and seizing it from a third party who received it from the suspect and concealed it? Are the intent to conceal evidence or the suspect status as a suspect for the crime of concealment of evidence on the part of the third party who concealed the information storage medium an essential element in determining whether participation rights should be guaranteed to the principal offender? In all of these cases, should the principal offender, as the owner/manager of the information storage medium, not still be regarded as having the interest in participation through exclusion of irrelevant information as the exclusive manager/disposer of the electronic information? From the perspective of participation rights, are the investigative procedure against the principal offender and the investigative procedure against the evidence concealer truly and substantively completely independent separate procedures, or is the latter substantially subsumed as part of the former? Since the principal offender and the evidence concealer each occupy the status of suspect while simultaneously and overlap-wise occupying the status of a third party with respect to the other party’s criminal suspicion, can each not become a subject to whom participation rights belong?
The structure of the principal offender and the evidence concealer contains a variety of issues for debate in determining the subject to whom participation rights belong. Focusing on these many special features, the dissenting opinion is the result of an effort to find answers to the above questions and, based on the precedents concerning the guarantee of participation rights, to determine the essence of participation rights and the core indicia of the subject to whom they belong. Based on the discussion developed by the dissenting opinion, I hope that this will provide an opportunity for active additional discussion on the scope and direction of participation-right guarantees in seizure and search procedures concerning information storage media in an increasingly advanced information society.

question: 신체의 liberty에 관한 explanations 중 which of the following are all incorrect? (Where there is a dispute, according to precedents) (a) 외국에서 형의 전부 or 일부를 served한 person에 대하여 sentence를 reduce or exempt할 수 있도록 하는 statutory provision은 legislator의 legislative discretion 범위 내에 속하므로 personal liberty를 침해하지 않는다. (b) punishment와는 달리, a security measure는 actor의 future recidivism risk에 based하고, whether to pronounce a security measure는 act time이 아니라 trial time의 recidivism risk assessment에 따라 determined되므로, 어떤 security measure가 penal character가 strong하고 personal liberty deprivation에 equivalent한 정도로 liberty를 restrict하더라도 the principle of non-retroactivity of punishment는 apply되지 않는다. (c) Immigration Control Act에 따라 detained된 foreigners를 Habeas Corpus Act상 relief petition을 file할 수 있는 detainees의 scope에서 excluding하는 것은 Habeas Corpus Act에 따른 detention의 legality를 contest할 opportunity를 deprive하는 것이어서 personal liberty를 infringe한다. (d) deportation order를 받은 person이 immediately outside the Republic of Korea로 deport될 수 없으면 deportation becomes possible할 때까지 detention facility에 detained할 수 있도록 stating한 statutory provision은 administrative convenience와 uniformity만을 emphasize한 것이므로 personal liberty를 infringe한다. (e) right to meet and communicate with counsel은 constitutional provisions에照らして, arrested or detained suspects or accused persons themselves에만 limited되는 personal liberty에 관한 fundamental right이지, those provisions로부터 a right of counsel to meet and communicate with an arrested or detained suspect or accused person이 derive된다고는 말할 수 없다.

with labor for not less than 1 year.\\n\\nArticle 38 (Penalties) Where a person subject to attachment violates Article 14 (including cases where it applies mutatis mutandis pursuant to Articles 27 and otherwise impairs its utility, he or she shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than 7 years or by a fine not exceeding 20 million won.\\n\\nArticle 39 (Penalties) ① Where a person subject to attachment violates the compliance requirement under Article 9-2(1) subparagraph 3 or 4 without justifiable grounds, he or she shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than 3 years or by a fine for release under paragraph 1 shall be as follows:\\n1. {"[2012HEONMA686]": "[별지] relevant provisions
인신보호법(2007. 12. 21. Act No. 8724로 제정된 것)
Article 1(목적) 이 법은 unconstitutional administrative disposition 또는 private person에 의한 시설 수용으로 인하여 unjustly personal liberty가 제한되고 있는 individuals의 relief procedures를 마련함으로써「헌법」이 보장하는 국민의 basic rights를 보호하는 것을 목적으로 한다.
인신보호법(2010. 6. 10. Act No. 10364로 개정된 것)
Article 3(구제청구) detainee에 대한 detention이 unlawfully commenced되거나 lawful detention 후 그 ground가 ceased to exist했음에도 계속 detained되어 있는 때에는 detainee, 그의 statutory representative, guardian, spouse, lineal relative, sibling, cohabitant, employer 또는 detention facility worker(이하 “petitioner for relief”라 한다)는 이 법이 정하는 바에 따라 court에 relief를 petition할 수 있다. 다만, 다른 Act에 relief procedure가 있는 경우에는 상당한 기간 내에 그 Act에 따른 relief를 받을 수 없음이 clearly impossible하여야 한다.
Immigration Control Act(2014. 3. 18. Act No. 12421로 개정된 것)
Article 46(Persons Subject to Deportation) ① 지방출입국·외국인관서의 장은 이 Chapter에 규정된 procedures에 따라 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 foreigner를 Republic of Korea 밖으로 deport할 수 있다.
(각호 생략)
Article 51(Detention) ① immigration control officer는 외국인이 Article 46 paragraph 1의 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당한다고 suspect할 만한 reasonable grounds가 있고 flight risk가 있으면 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장으로부터 detention order를 얻어 그 foreigner를 detain할 수 있다.
③ urgent case에서 외국인이 Article 46 paragraph 1의 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당한다고 suspect할 만한 reasonable grounds가 있고 flight risk 또는 possibility of flight가 있으며 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장으로부터 detention order를 얻을 time이 없을 때에는 immigration control officer는 그 reason을 inform함으로써 foreigner를 urgently detain할 수 있다.
Article 52(Period and Place of Detention) ① Article 51에 따라 detained된 foreigner가 deportation subject인지 examine and determine하기 위한 detention period는 within 10 days로 한다. 다만, unavoidable reason이 있으면 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장의 permission을 받아 10일을 초과하지 아니하는 범위에서 only once 연장할 수 있다.
Article 55(Objection to Detention) ① detention order에 따라 detained된 person 또는 his or her statutory representative 등은 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장을 거쳐 Minister of Justice에게 detention에 대한 objection을 file할 수 있다.
② Minister of Justice는 제1항에 따른 objection을 받은 경우 without delay 관계 서류를 examine하여 그 objection이 without merit라고 인정되면 decision으로 dismiss하고, well-founded라고 인정되면 decision으로 detained person's release from detention을 order하여야 한다.
③ 제2항에 따른 decision before, 필요하면 Minister of Justice는 persons concerned의 statements를 hear할 수 있다.
Article 63(Detention and Release from Detention of a Person Who Has Received a Deportation Order) ① 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장은 deportation order를 받은 사람을 passport not having 또는 transportation not secured 등의 reason으로 즉시 Republic of Korea 밖으로 repatriate할 수 없으면 repatriate할 수 있을 때까지 그를 detention facility에 detain할 수 있다.
② 제1항에 따라 detaining할 때 그 period가 3 months를 초과하는 경우에는 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장은 every 3 months 미리 Minister of Justice의 prior approval을 받아야 한다.
③ 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장은 제2항의 approval을 받지 못하면 without delay 그 사람의 detention을 release하여야 한다.
④ 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장은 deportation order를 받은 사람이 another country로부터 entry denied되는 등의 reason으로 repatriated될 수 없음이 clear해진 경우에는 그의 detention을 release할 수 있다.
⑤ 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장은 제3항 또는 제4항에 따라 detention을 release하는 경우에는 residence restriction 또는 other necessary conditions를 attach할 수 있다.
⑥ 제1항에 따라 detention하는 경우에는 Articles 53 through 55, Articles 56-2 through 56-9, and Article 57 shall apply mutatis mutandis.
Immigration Control Act(2010. 5. 14. Act No. 10282로 개정된 것)
Article 51(Detention) ② 제1항에 따른 detention order issuance를 apply할 때에는 detention necessity를 establish할 수 있는 materials를 attach and submit하여야 한다.
④ immigration control officer는 제3항에 따라 foreigner를 urgently detain하면 immediately emergency detention notice를 prepare하여 그 foreigner에게 show하여야 한다.
⑤ immigration control officer는 제3항에 따라 foreigner를 detain한 경우에는 within 48 hours detention order를 obtain하여 foreigner에게 show하여야 하며, detention order를 obtain하지 못한 경우에는 immediately detention을 release하여야 한다.
Article 52(Period and Place of Detention) ② detention may be made places는 foreigner detention room, foreigner detention center, 또는 Minister of Justice가 designated하는 other place(이하 “detention facility”라 한다)로 한다."}

{"[2013HEONMA129]": "The Petitioner filed this 헌법소원심판 case seeking the 취소 of the 기소유예의 불기소처분, which the Respondent 결정 on 2012. 11. 30. in relation to the assault case No. 2012HYEONGJE15580 at the 대구지방검찰청 포항지청, alleging that it infringes the Petitioner’s 헌법상 보장된 평등권 등 기본권을.

However, even upon the record of this case을 자세히 살펴보아도, it does not appear that the Respondent conducted a 수사 with respect to the above case that was 현저히 형평에 반하는, or that there was any 중대한 잘못 in the 헌법의 해석, 법률의 적용, or 증거판단 that affected the decision to issue the 불기소처분, and there is otherwise no material from which to conclude that the Respondent’s 이 사건 처분 is an 자의적 처분 to such an extent that the Constitutional Court would be 관여할 정도로 concerned; therefore, it cannot be said that the fundamental rights asserted by the Petitioner were 침해되었다고 볼 수 없다.

Accordingly, since the petition for 심판 in this case is 이유 없으므로, it is decided to 기각하기로 하여, and the decision is made as stated in the 주문, by the 일치된 의견 of all Justices participating.

{"[2015HEONMA1204]": "1. 사건개요
가. suspect 윤○현은 2015. 10. 5. 19:00경 arrest warrant에 의하여 체포되어 detention warrant가 청구되었다. Claimant인 attorney는 위 suspect 가족들의 위임을 받아 2015. 10. 6. 17:00경 사건을 investigate 중인 Respondent ○○District Prosecutors’ Office prosecutor(이하 ‘Respondent Prosecutor’라고 한다)에게 counsel visitation이 가능한지 telephone로 문의한 후, 같은 날 19:00경 visitation application을 지참한 채 ○○District Prosecutors’ Office ○○호 prosecutor’s office room을 방문하여 Respondent Prosecutor에게 counsel visitation application을 하였다.
나. 위 suspect escort를 담당한 Respondent ○○Detention Center correctional officer(이하 ‘Respondent Correctional Officer’라고 한다)는 같은 날 17:00경 Respondent Prosecutor’s office에서 위 suspect를 custody 받아 prosecutor’s office 내 detention room에 대기시켰다가, 같은 날 19:10경 Respondent Prosecutor로부터 night questioning을 위한 suspect summon 요청을 받고 위 suspect를 prosecutor’s office로 brought in 하였다.
다. Respondent Prosecutor는 Respondent Correctional Officer에게 Claimant의 visitation application이 있었음을 알렸고, Respondent Correctional Officer는 ○○Detention Center counsel visitation 담당 official에게 그 handling procedure에 관하여 문의한 후, Claimant에게 ‘Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners Enforcement Decree’ 제58조 제1항에 따라 ‘Regulations on the Service of National Public Officials’상 working hours(09:00～18:00)가 경과하여 counsel visitation을 허용할 수 없다고 informed 하였다.
라. 그 후 Respondent Prosecutor는 Claimant의 visitation application에 대하여 further action을 취하지 아니하였고, Claimant는 prosecutor’s office에 머무르다가 ultimately 위 suspect를 visit하지 못한 채 left 하였다. Respondent Prosecutor는 Claimant가 left한 이후 위 suspect에 대한 questioning을 계속하였으며, Claimant는 위 suspect의 counsel로 appointed되지 못하였다.
마. Claimant는 위와 같이 counsel visitation application을 refuse한 Respondents의 acts와 Respondent Correctional Officer가 그 legal basis로 삼은 ‘Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners Enforcement Decree’ 제58조 제1항이 자신의 fundamental rights를 침해하였다고 주장하면서, 2015. 12. 28. 이 사건 constitutional complaint를 filed 하였다.
2. Subject Matter of Adjudication
이 사건 subject matter는 ① 2015. 10. 6. 19:00경 ○○District Prosecutors’ Office ○○호 prosecutor’s office room에서 Claimant와 suspect 윤○현의 visitation을 permit하기 위한 measures를 취하지 않은 Respondents의 acts(이하 Respondent Prosecutor의 visitation denial을 ‘this case Prosecutor’s denial of visitation’라고 하고, Respondent Correctional Officer의 visitation denial을 ‘this case Correctional Officer’s denial of visitation’이라 하며, 이들을 collectively ‘this case denial of visitation’라고 한다), ② ‘Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners Enforcement Decree’(wholly amended by Presidential Decree No. 21095 on 2008. 10. 29.) 제58조 제1항(이하 ‘this case Visitation Hours Provision’이라 한다)이 Claimant의 fundamental rights를 infringe하는지 여부이다(이하 ‘Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners’를 ‘Execution of Sentences Act’이라 한다).
심판대상조항 및 related provisions는 다음과 같다.
[Provision Subject to Adjudication]
Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners Enforcement Decree(wholly amended by Presidential Decree No. 21095 on 2008. 10. 29.)
Article 58 (Visitation) (1) visitation by a prisoner shall take place every day(excluding public holidays and days designated by the Minister of Justice) within working hours pursuant to Article 9 of the Regulations on the Service of National Public Officials.
[Related Provisions]
Criminal Procedure Act(enacted by Act No. 341 on 1954. 9. 23.)
Article 34(Visitation, Communication, and Medical Treatment with Defendant or Suspect) A defense counsel or a person who intends to become defense counsel may visit a defendant or suspect who is under physical restraint and may exchange documents or articles with him or her, and may have a physician provide treatment.
Criminal Procedure Act(amended by Act No. 8496 on 2007. 6. 1.)
Article 243-2(Participation of Defense Counsel, etc.) (1) A prosecutor or judicial police officer shall, upon application by a suspect or his or her defense counsel, legal representative, spouse, lineal relative, brother, or sister, allow defense counsel to visit the suspect or allow defense counsel to participate in the interrogation of the suspect unless there is a justifiable ground.
(2) to (5) Omitted
Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners(wholly amended by Act No. 8728 on 2007. 12. 21.)
Article 3(Scope of Application) This Act applies to the premises of correctional institutions and to other places where correctional officers are guarding prisoners and where the control of correctional officers is required.
Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners Enforcement Decree(amended by Presidential Decree No. 25397 on 2014. 6. 25.)
Article 58(Visitation) (1) Omitted
(2) Except for untried prisoners who visit with defense counsel(including persons intending to become defense counsel; the same shall apply hereinafter), the visitation time for prisoners shall be limited to not more than 30 minutes per visit.
(3) The number of visits by prisoners shall be four times per month.
(4) Visitation by prisoners shall take place in a place equipped with contact-blocking facilities; provided, however, that this shall not apply in any of the following cases:
1. Where an untried prisoner(including a convicted prisoner under investigation or trial in a criminal case and a person sentenced to death whose sentence has become final and conclusive) visits with defense counsel
2. Where a prisoner visits with an attorney who is a representative in a litigation case, and where there is no risk of undermining the safety or order of the correctional institution
(5) Except for the matters prescribed in the Act and this Decree, necessary matters concerning the number, time, place, etc. of visits by prisoners other than convicted prisoners, persons sentenced to death, and untried prisoners shall be determined by the Minister of Justice.
